articleTitle: Research of ADR mechanism in low mobility scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As one of promising and valuable low-power Wide Area Network (WAN) technologies, LoRaWAN has been in the limelight among the scholars at home and abroad. Adaptive Data Rate (ADR) has been introduced in LoRaWAN, because it can adjust Spreading Factor (SF) and Transmission Power (TP) according to the changes of network topology and changes of network topology and channel conditions. The ADR mechanism can enable LoRa nodes to maintain a certain network performance while trying not to lose the reliability of network topology. LoRaWAN is widely used not only on fixed devices, but also on mobile devices. In this paper, the flexibility of ADR mechanism in low mobility environment was studied by means of the FLora framework of OMNet++ simulation software. We first optimized the parameters of ADR mechanism in low mobility environment, and then changed the moving speed of LoRa node to observe its relationship with the effect of ADR mechanism. We found that the network performance will be improved by 12 % when the node moves at a specific speed compared with the case of static nodes. In addition, we also compared the convergence speeds of ADR algorithm at node (Node-ADR) and ADR algorithm at network server (Net-ADR). The simulation results show that the convergence speed of Net-ADR algorithm is about 6 % faster than Node-ADR algorithm.

articleTitle: Sparse Andrew's Sine Norm Promoting Adaptive Algorithm under Non-Gaussian Noises
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Two sparse adaptive filtering (AF) algorithms based on Andrew's sine estimator (ASE) are presented to achieve improved performance for identifying sparse systems, where the ASE is derived within the least-square framework. Furthermore, zero-attracting (ZA) scheme is used in ASE to construct ZA-ASE and its re-weighting form (RZA-ASE) to combat non-Gaussian noises and use the sparse characteristics of the system. Their performance is investigated via simulations and compared with the least-mean square (LMS) and the maximum correntropy criterion (MCC) algorithms to show their superior performance.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study Between Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface and Reflectarray Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper firstly reviews the geometries and functionalities of the reflectarray antenna (RTA) and the recon-figurable intelligent surface (RIS). The similarities and differences between the two in structural materials, far/near field division, and their general applications are studied.

articleTitle: Measurement and Ray-tracing for UAV Air-to-air Channel Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have been widely used for both civil and mission-critical applications with ever-increasing values in the next decade. The UAV channel shows some unique characteristics due to high mobility and variable attitudes of the UAVs. In this paper, an air-to-air (A2A) channel at 1420 MHz in the urban scenario is measured. The delay and power of the multipath components (MPCs) are analyzed based on the measurement data. Besides, a ray-tracing (RT) simulator is calibrated to be applicable for more UAV scenarios, through which extensive simulations are conducted. The attitude of the moving UAV is set to change during the RT simulations, including pitch-up, cruise, and pitch-down flight. Correspondingly, tapped-delay line (TDL) models of A2A channels are developed. Moreover, Doppler spectrum of each tap is modeled by Jakes spectrum. The proposed channel models can be helpful for designing UAV communication systems.

articleTitle: Standardization Progress and Challenges for 5G MIMO OTA Performance Testing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: New difficulties of user equipment (UE) performance testing have been brought up with the development of 5G key technologies. Standardization progress and testing methods of 5G multi-input and multi-output (MIMO) over-the-air (OTA) performance testing is reviewed in this paper. The comparison of 5G and 4G testing methods specified in the standard are highlighted and discussed. The potential challenges and research directions are also presented for further progress on this topic.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized $4\times 4$ Butler Matrix Using Distributed Capacitors in the Quasi-Arbitrary Phase-Difference Hybrid Coupler
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This communication describes a miniaturized <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4\times 4$</tex> Butler Matrix Using Distributed capacitors in the Quasi-Arbitrary Phase-Difference Hybrid Coupler. First, A traditional branch-line coupler with any phase difference can be calculated by the impedance and phase of each short side. next, a transmission line can be replaced by a high impedance transmission line and parallel capacitors. To miniaturize the circuit, all distributed capacitances are placed inside the branch coupler. On the basis of the compact branch coupler configuration, the compact Butler matrix needs to eliminate the independent phase shifter and frequency divider. A distributed capacitive branch coupler with arbitrary phase difference is proposed to replace the traditional branch coupler. Through the miniaturized design of branch couplers and the elimination of phase shifters and crossover junctions, the design of the butler matrix is 66% smaller than the traditional butler matrix design proceedings.

articleTitle: Factor Graph Localization Algorithm Based on Robust Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs), the performance requirements of unmanned vehicle positioning system are also gradually improved. Existing unmanned ground vehicles need to use a variety of sensors to provide measurement information, and the available positioning information is dynamically combined in the positioning system and the positioning results are calculated. In this paper, multi-source information fusion positioning system of unmanned ground vehicles is established based on factor graph model. In order to solve the problem that the factor graph algorithm is difficult to identify and exclude abnormal observations autonomously, this paper combines the robust estimation with the factor graph to improve the factor graph method. The reliability factor is added in the construction of the factor node, which can be adjusted adaptively according to the current measured value to reduce the weight of abnormal observations and ensure the normal operation of the system. Simulation results show that the improved factor graph algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the influence of abnormal observations on positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Cross Deployment of Active and Passive Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RISs) for Next-Generation Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) technologies have been proposed due to its ability in shaping propagation environment for future 6G network development. Existing RIS technologies mainly include the active reconfigurable intelligent surface (ARIS) and the passive reconfigurable intelligent surface (PRIS). In this paper, according to the characteristics of RIS and demands of lower costs, we present a new strategy on the cross-deployment of ARIS and PRIS that meets the beneficial maximization in both capital cost and running cost.

articleTitle: Research on UAV-to-Ground Communication Channel Based on NYUSIM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In B5G era, millimeter wave (mmWave) has received wide attention because of its abundant spectrum resources. Low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) can effectively compensate the shortcomings of small coverage and weak penetration of mmWave by virtue of its low cost and mobility characteristics, so the combination of UAV and mmWave communication are promising for next generation mobile system. To reveal the characterization of Air-to-Ground (A2G) channel for UAV communications, this paper simulates different distances, different altitudes and different weather conditions on Sub-6GHz and millimeter-wave bands through NYUSIM platform. The data has been fitted with a logarithmic distance path loss model and the K-factors has been extracted for comparative analysis. In addition, the power delay profile (PDP) and root mean square delay spread (RMS-DS) are calculated to analyze the time dispersion characteristics. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the propagation characteristics of mmWave A2G channels at different scales, which provides a reference for the design of UAV communication systems and the planning of low-altitude cellular networks.

articleTitle: Ray-tracing based 5G Coverage Analysis and Capacity Evaluation in an Indoor Hotspot Scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As an important scenario in the vision of “smart buildings”, office buildings are a typical indoor hotspot environment and therefore, require seamless connectivity and massive data transfer with Gbps throughput. In China, the band of 3.3-3.4 GHz has been allocated for the indoor deployment of fifth-generation mobile communication system (5G). Compared to lower frequencies, the 3.3-3.4 GHz band suffers a larger propagation loss. Moreover, modern office buildings are composed of various scenarios such as open/closed offices, open spaces, corridors, and so on which have distinguished physical and geometrical features that complicate wave propagation. As a result, it is challenging to deploy a high-quality 5G network in such a complex indoor environment. In this paper, we conduct extensive ray-tracing (RT) simulations in a typical office building at the 3.3-3.4 GHz band. Based on the findings through analyzing the coverage in every separate scenario, a solution of optimal deployment of transmitters (TXs) is presented to meet the requirement of the synchronization signal reference signal received power (SS-RSRP). The channel capacity is evaluated through system-level simulations, implying that with the proposed solution in this paper, the peak throughput can reach 1.5 Gbps in certain areas while future efforts should be made to improve the throughput in the areas suffering strong interference caused by omni-directional Tx antennas. These results provide valuable insights into the system design and evaluation for 5G communication-empowered smart buildings.

articleTitle: Analysis of Ship RCS Interpolation Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Radar cross section (RCS) is a physical quantity that measures the echo intensity of a target under the illumination of radar waves, namely, the virtual area of the target. The acquisition methods of RCS are generally divided into two categories which are actual measurement and simulation, respectively. But it is time-consuming to get the data of any angle of the ship target RCS, whether to use electromagnetic simulation or actual measurement. So if part of the data of RCS is known, it should be possible to estimate the other RCS data based on them. So, the performance of different interpolation methods are compared by the statistical characteristics and the degree of similarity between raw data and interpolated data; then, the most suitable interpolation method is selected to fulfill the requirement of generating the RCS of the ship target at any angle.

articleTitle: Load and Mutual Sense Recognition Method for MCRWPT Systems Based on LCC-S Type Compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A method is proposed for the identification of the load and mutual inductance of magnetically coupled resonant wireless energy transmission systems(MCRWPT) based on an improved grey wolf optimization algorithm, in order to address the problem that the mutual inductance of the coupling mechanism and the load varies with large hours and is difficult to identify. The method converts the mutual inductance and load identification problem into an optimization problem by using the real-time current mathematical model at the transmitter as the identification model and the minimum real-time current error at the transmitter as the target, and obtains the real-time load and mutual inductance values of the system by solving the model with the improved grey wolf optimisation algorithm. The experimental results show that the maximum error between the mutual inductance and load values obtained from the discrimination and the actual values is maintained within 1.78% This result indicates that the improved grey wolf optimization algorithm can identify the current system state quickly and accurately, which is conducive to the real-time control of the system.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Dual-Circularly Polarized Shared-Aperture mmWave Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a substrate integration waveguide (SIW) dual-band dual-circularly polarized (CP) antenna is proposed. The antenna is composed of three components i.e., low-frequency feed structure, SIW cavity, and polarization converter. In the high-frequency band, the TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">010</inf> mode of the SIW cylindrical cavity is excited by a probe. A slot is etched on the top of the SIW cavity and the linear-circular polarization converter is top-loaded to generate right-handed circularly polarized (RHCP) radiation. In the low-frequency band, the SIW cavity operates as a circular patch. The patch is excited by two branches of the Y-shaped slot to generate left-handed circularly polarized (LHCP) radiation. The simulated results show that the proposed antenna obtains −10 dB impedance bandwidths of 18.65-21.15 GHz and 30.1-31.3 GHz. The 3 dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidths are 18.85-21.15 GHz and 29.8-31.8 GHz with the peak gains of 6 dBi and 3 dBi at the corresponding bandwidths. The isolations of input ports are better than 34 dB and 20 dB, for the dual operating frequencies, respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Marine Wireless Communication Channel under High Sea Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The study of maritime electromagnetic wave communication channels is significant for the robustness of the communication of marine unmanned aerial vehicles(UAVs). For the case of calm sea condition, the two-ray or three-day model is usually used for the analysis. However, sub-case research is needed for the high sea conditions. So this paper uses the sea surface spectrum to generate the sea surface scenarios at high sea conditions and then uses the ray-tracing algorithm to analyse the marine UAV communication in the UHF band. The transmission path loss curves and multipath propagation of electromagnetic wave transmission under different sea conditions and altitudes are investigated in this paper.

articleTitle: Interference Suppression for Radar Signal using 2D UNet based on Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The wide application of automotive radars significantly increases the possibility of mutual interference. Interference can lead to false detections such as ghost objects and missed detections, with serious threats to vehicle and pedestrian safety. In this paper, we build an end-to-end interference suppression model using 2D UNet. The UNet takes the input through the encoder with down-sampling to get a feature smaller than the initial data, and then inputs this feature into the decoder and reduces it to the clean signal, thus achieving interference suppression. By providing the network with clean data and interference-contaminated data, the network can be well trained to mitigate the interference artifacts. Experimental results show that the proposed scheme could achieve superior performance compared with traditional signal processing algorithms, in which the target peak was preserved and the signal-to-noise ratio (SINR) was significantly improved.

articleTitle: An FPGA-based Fall Detection System Using Millimeter-wave Radar and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Falls have become the second leading cause of unintentional injury death in the elderly. Timely detection of falls in the elderly can avoid greater injuries. Therefore, it is increasingly important to study fall detection systems. Based on this background, a fall detection system is designed in this paper. A fall detection system is usually divided into two parts: data acquisition and feature recognition. Due to its excellent confidentiality and applicability, millimeter-wave radar is used for data acquisition in this paper. Usually, the data collected by millimeter-wave radar is processed in a computer, and feedback is given to fall or not. But the data processing software in the computer brings great convenience to the system at the same time, it also limits the stability and portability of the system and hinders the practical application of the system. For this, the system introduces FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) to replace the computer for all the data processing including short-time Fourier transform and CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) feature recognition. Experimental results show that the system can detect falls accurately in simple cases, which preliminarily proved the feasibility of FPGA application in the fall detection system. The FPGA-based fall detection system can realize miniaturization and low price through tape-out after further improvement, and promote the practical application of the fall detection system.

articleTitle: A Design of Flexible Materials Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A microstrip antenna based on flexible materials is designed. It adopts a flexible dielectric substrate, a radiating patch, a microstrip feeding method and a floor slot structure. Its size is 24mm×14mm×0.038mm, which conforms to the trend of antenna miniaturization. The electromagnetic simulation software Ansoft HFSS is used to simulate and optimize the antenna in the planar state and the conformal state. The results show that it can work in the 5G operation frequency bands of 2.49-2.69GHz and 5.15-5.85GHz in the planar state and the conformal state, which has the characteristic of omnidirectional radiation and its maximum gain is 4.4dBi.

articleTitle: A Single-layer Reflectarray Antenna for Sub-THz Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, a single-layer reflectarray element with high efficiency is presented. The element of the reflectarray is composed of metal patches printed on both sides of the substrate. A phase coverage of 360° can be achieved by adjusting the upper patch arm length, the expansion coefficient, and the contraction coefficient. Besides, the reflection amplitude is good. Based on these settings, a 17×17 reflective array antenna is designed. The maximum gain of this antenna is 23.75 dBi. In addition, the antenna achieves a 1-dB gain bandwidth of 15% and a 3-dB gain bandwidth of 33%.

articleTitle: Accurate Antenna Design by Deep Auto-encoder Surrogate Model Assisted Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is an evolutionary algorithm based on swarm cooperation and can deal with arbitrary optimization problems effectively. Therefore, PSO has been widely used in antenna design. Traditional antenna design approach (directly using PSO with an electromagnetic (EM) simulator) requires a massive amount of EM simulations during each optimization iteration, which is very time consuming. To address this situation, a novel approach using deep convolutional auto-encoder (DC-AE) assisted particle swarm optimization is proposed to design antenna. Using the antenna data collected by EM solver to train d-ae, the surrogate model is established. The surrogate model can predict the response of antenna unknown physical parameters quickly and accurately, which accelerates the iterative process of PSO. An antenna design example is used to demonstrate the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Research on Decoupling of a Dual-band Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-patch dual-band antenna is introduced, in which the rectangular slot is digged to achieve dual-band characteristics. Due to the strong coupling effect between the independent bands of the two patch antennas, a precisely designed metasurface is considered to be imposed on the antenna to increase its isolation. The design proposed in the paper is modeled and simulated, and the antenna isolation is effectively improved in the two operation bands. At the same time, the reflection coefficient of the antenna performs well.

articleTitle: General Sparse Normalization and Proportionate ASE Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Andrew's Sine Estimator (ASE) has recently been used to invent adaptive filtering, which can combat more kind of noises than conventional estimators. Inspired by the LMS and its sparse forms, normalization and proportionate ASE algorithms with Lawson constraints are constructed with the respective given names of Lawson normalization ASE (LNASE) and Lawson proportionate NASE (LPNASE). Simulations are performed to analyze the performance of these algorithms under impulsive noise.

articleTitle: Incremental Second Order Volterra Filter Based on Maximum Correntropy Criteria over Distributed Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper develops an incremental least mean square second order Volterra (IncLMS-SOV) to estimate the coefficients of distributed volterra network. Furthermore, to significantly suppress impulsive noises, an incremental second order Volterra based on maximum correntropy criteria (MCC) is also developed, which is attained by coping with the correntropy-based optimizing problem. No matter when the impulsive noise occurs, the correntropy-based functions could steeply decline the step size of the adaptive filter. Thus, the proposed IncMCC-SOV can maintain stability while impulsive interferences occur. Moreover, to suppress the balance problem between convergence speed and steady-state error caused by kernel width, we also proposed a novel adaptive variable kernel width IncMCC-SOV algorithm.

articleTitle: A Wideband Omnidirectional MIMO Antenna for WiFi-6E Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A wideband omnidirectional multiple-in multiple-out (MIMO) antenna for WiFi-6E applications is presented in this letter. The antenna operates at 2.37-3.04 GHz (24.7%) and 4.8-7.84 GHz (48.1%), which can cover WiFi-6E triple bands. An array including eight antenna elements is formed around a router. The antenna element has a planar structure with a compact size 48 × 8 × 1 mm <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, Simulations results show that the peak gain of antenna element varies in 3.71-5.15 dBi and 1.94-6.05 dBi within the above-mentioned dual bandwidths.

articleTitle: Study on Scattering Porperties of Moving Cone-Sphere Shape Coated with Plasma Sheath
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the Lorentz finite-difference time-domain method (Lorentz-FDTD) is used to study the interaction between high-speed moving cone-sphere target coated with plasma sheath and electromagnetic (EM) wave. When the target is in different moving states, the influence of moving state on radar echo and radar cross section (RCS) of target coated by plasma is analyzed in this paper. Firstly, the Lorentz-FDTD algorithm in dispersion media is derived. And then, the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of the moving cone-sphere target coated by plasma is studied with the Lorentz-FDTD method. The calculation results show that the motion state of the target will modulate the frequency and amplitude of the scattered EM waves. Besides, the plasma sheath coated on the surface of target will have an effect on the target far-scattered field.

articleTitle: Wideband RCS Enhancement Based on Phase Gradient Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, a reflection phase gradient metasurface is proposed to realize wideband backscattering enhancement performance. Based on the generalized Snell's law, the phase difference between adjacent metasurface cells is calculated with specific retroreflective direction firstly. As a proof of concept, a square loop unit cell with different dimensions is then designed to achieve the effective reflection phase range. Furthermore, in order to obtain a wideband backward RCS enhancement, the metasurface unit cells are designed with 2-bit coding sequence. Simulation results show that the presented whole retrodirective metasurface can realize effective RCS enhancement in X band, compared to the same-sized PEC plate.

articleTitle: Ship Target Detection Method Based on Local Saliency Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Due to the non-uniformity of ship target scattering, speckle noises and side lobes, synthetic aperture radar (SAR) ship target detection is facing great challenges. Therefore, to improve the detection performance in this scenario, the ship detection method based on the local saliency enhancement is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the proposed method improves the target-to-clutter ratio (TCR) by combining the relative differences of multi-features between ship target and the clutter background, and the threshold segmentation is performed based on the final local enhancement results. The experimental results show that the proposed method can suppress clutter background and speckle noises, improve the TCR and the algorithm has a high detection rate and a low false alarm rate in the complex background and multi-target marine environment.

articleTitle: Anti-jamming Method of Satellite Navigation Based on Synthetic Aperture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new method to extend the satellite navigation anti-jamming degree of freedom based on synthetic aperture is proposed. In this paper, by means of using the motion characteristics of single antenna, the time-domain sampling of signal is converted into spatial sampling and virtual array is synthesized. When the number of virtual elements in the array is limited, the number of interferences which can be suppressed can be greatly increased, which can solve the problem that the freedom of anti-interference is limited by the number of elements. Combined with the optimal anti-jamming weighting criterion, the space-frequency anti-jamming algorithm is used for anti-jamming processing, and the covariance matrix broadening algorithm is used to optimize the anti-jamming processing results, which solves the problem of how to deal with robust anti-jamming under the condition of unfixed anti-jamming degree of freedom. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Four-arm Archimedean Spiral Antenna with Multi-mode Orbital Angular Momentum
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A four-arm Archimedean spiral multi-mode OAM (Orbital Angular Momentum) antenna with bandwidth of 1.34GHz-9.53GHz is presented and analyzed. The bandwidth of traditional OAM antenna is dramatically improved by utilizing the self-complementarity between the arms of Archimede spiral. Comparing to the dual arm helical antenna, the vortex electromagnetic wave phase for the proposed scheme shows better continuity and purity, simultaneously more modes are realized. The reflector is arranged under the ground to make the antenna achieve unidirectional radiation characteristics and reduce backward radiation. The mode for l= 0, l= 1, l= 2 and mixed mode l= 1.2 are realized by controlling phase of the four different feed ports. Finally, the effects about the rotation radius for the Archimede spiral on the patterns with various arm width is investigated and discussed. The results are significant consistency with the design, and concurrently superb vortex characteristics are achieved in different modes.

articleTitle: Position Servo Control Method of Manipulator based on Improved Active Disturbance Rejection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the author in-depth study on the key techniques of the AC servo system for manipulator. Through the analysis of the application characteristics of the manipulator servo control system, the joint position servo control algorithm is optimized to improve the position control accuracy of the joint output end. Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) is selected as the servo drive system of the mechanical arm. Linear Auto-Disturbance Rejection(LADRC) control algorithm is designed to improve the speed loop and position loop of the control system, and the extended state observer is improved to improve the disturbance observation performance. At the same time, the inertia identification model of the system is designed with reference to the adaptive algorithm to reduce the influence of system inertia error on performance. The experimental results show that this method improves the disturbance performance and response speed of the system, thereby improving the position control precision of the joint[1].

articleTitle: A High-Efficiency Ultral-Wideband Dual-Polarization Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The ultra-wideband(UWB) large-angle scan array antenna is the base of electronic countermeasures and wideband radar. Almost the ultra-wideband array are the tightly coupled array, and all the antenna element spacing of the array is less than half a wavelength of highest frequency. A new 3: 1 bandwidth dual-polarization tightly coupled array antenna is designed. The new antenna is a pure metal vivaldi antenna, and it's feed by the inner conductor of a RF connector directly. The antenna element spacing is bigger than half a wavelength of highest frequency, by adjust the thickness of the antenna to enhance the coupling between antenna elements, which means the antenna has higher efficiency. By use two-dimensional periodic boundary in HFSS, the antenna is simulated and optimized. The antenna is measured, the active-VSWRs at 6-18GHz are blew 3, the unweighted side lobe is less than −13dB, and the cross-polarization within the operation band are better than −25dB.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional Eletrostatically Actuated MEMS Micromirror
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Recently, the development of LiDAR in the field of vehicle has made the core micromirror with essential characteristics of large tilted angle and small size. We proposed a two-dimensional electrostatically actuated MEMS micromirror with a slender torsion bar. With the modified theoretical formula, two different torsional modes and corresponding torsional frequencies of the micromirror are obtained, which are then compared to the results by finite element simulation, and revealed a good agreement. The rotation angle of the micromirror is improved through optimizing the micromirror structure. Meanwhile, it is found that the driving voltage and the moment of inertia introduce the softening behavior of the spring, which will then affect the torsion frequency. To prevent the torsion bar stress is too large, with the sinusoidal driving voltage of 75V and 100V, the corresponding mechanical rotation angles are 14.8° and 15.3° at a driving frequency of 340.5Hz and 1500Hz, respectively.

articleTitle: Stackelberg Game for Data offloading in Parking - Vehicular Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: VANET has been a promising paradigm to offer low-latency service. Nevertheless, the massive mobile data demand brings huge challenges to the network. With the communication capabilities, the parked vehicle can be the communication node to meet the user traffic demand. To implement it, we propose an approach to incentivize users to offload data by using parked vehicles. The economic interactions of operator and user are formalized as a multi-user Stackelberg Game where the operator is leader and users are followers. The existence of Stackelberg equilibrium is guaranteed. We transform the multi-user problem into a single-user problem which is an integer programming problem. We relax the integer constraints that transform the original problem into linear programming and prove the optimal solution for the two problems is the same. An iterative algorithm was proposed to achieve the Stackelberg equilibrium. Finally, we provide numerical results to demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Design of Log-Periodic Koch Dipole Array (LPKDA) Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A miniaturized log-periodic Koch dipole array (LPKDA) antenna is proposed in this paper. With the T-shaped top construction and the novel Koch bifurcated folding dipole, the length of the single dipole element is reduced to the minimum, which immensely reduce the antenna size. The antenna operates in the frequency band of 195 ~ 848 MHz. The characteristics of compact structure, simple structure and wide band are achieved by the proposed antenna.

articleTitle: An Flexible Compact Antenna with Frequency Configurability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An mimic antenna is presented to work in different frequencies with a flexible frequency configurability using the two different switches on its radiating patch. Then, it was created in the FEM software to get a simulation model and its performance was analyzed when the switches are on/off to discuss the frequency configurability. Results obtaining from the FEM simulation give us a conclusion that the antenna can work in three different mode for WLAN and C-band communication systems. Also, the antenna for in each mode can also provide good omni-directional radiating patterns.

articleTitle: A Double-Layer Wideband Transmitarray Antenna for 5G Millimeter Wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-layer wideband transmitarray antenna for fifth-generation (5G) millimeter wave (MMW) applications is proposed. The transmitarray cell consists of four metal vias and two identical patches printed on the upper and lower sides of the dielectric substrate. The transmitarray antenna consists of 121 above-mentioned cells. The simulated results show that the presented transmitarray antenna has a 12.58% (38.79-44 GHz) 1-dB gain bandwidth.

articleTitle: A Discontinuous Galerkin Time Domain Method for Solving Drude Dispersive Models
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we derive the formula of discontinuous Galerkin time domain (DGTD) method for Maxwell's equations of linear dispersive Drude model. Auxiliary differential equations (ADE) are used to deal with frequency-dependent constitutive relations. The feasibility of the algorithm is verified by numerical examples.

articleTitle: A Novel Timing Synchronization Method for OFDM-Based UWA Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Symbol timing synchronization is of essential significance in the performance of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) systems. On the basis of symmetric sequences, the current study investigated a timing synchronization method intended for the OFDM system, which was applied to the underwater acoustic (UWA). As a consequence, a dramatic peak at the timing-correct location was generated by a superior pulse-like timing metric, although other components' values were marginal. Besides, the performance of the timing synchronization method was evaluated through computer simulation of the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), whose results indicated that the proposed method was superior to the typical Park method in Gaussian white noise channel environment.

articleTitle: Stagger PRI Radar Signal Deinterleaving based on Image Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Signal deinterleaving is an important prerequisite step for recognizing radar emitters. However, with the advancement of digital emission technology, traditional signal deinterleaving algorithms have difficulty in obtaining accurate results for complex stagger pulse repetition interval (PRI) signals. To solve this issue, a deinterleaving method based on the image semantic segmentation technique is proposed. This method can characterize the frequency features of different PRI types on pixel distribution, estimate the potential PRI of the sequence, and extract the corresponding pulse sequence by using a segmentation network. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method could achieve superior results for staggered radar emitters.

articleTitle: Variable Step Size Least Mean p-Power Algorithm Based on Improved Softsign Function
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The conventional adaptive filtering algorithm in signal processing with fixed step size will lead to its stability and convergence unable to be combined at the moment. To deal with this problem, the least mean p-power (LMP) algorithm is improved, and a variable step size least mean p-power algorithm based on an improved softsign function is proposed. The algorithm uses the improved softsign function to construct the variable step size function, while the moving weighted average method is applied to update the step size and keep the efficiency of the algorithm stable. Simulation experiments indicate that the improved variable step size LMP algorithm further reduces the steady-state error of the algorithm while maintaining the original convergence speed, thus better balancing the stability and convergence of the algorithm under the interference of ocean pulse noise compared with the existing fixed step size and variable step size algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on an Absoption-phase Cancellation Checkerboard Metasurface for RCS reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper designs a single-layer absorbing metasurface with 20dB RCS reduction by using the absorption-phase cancellation. The metasurface consists of two types of ultra-thin absorbing units with absorption properties greater than 10dB which have different reflection phases. The 20dB RCS reduction conditions of the two units are analyzed in term of considering absorption and phase cancellation. According to the above analysis, two types of metasurface units with absorbing performance and different reflection phases are designed to achieve RCS reduction. Simulation experiments show that the metasurface can achieve 20dB RCS reduction at 6-12.8GHz while the 10dB RCS reduction is 4.8-15.4GHz. The designed metasurface can increase the reduction to 20dB while maintaining the original bandwidth of 10dB, which has great potential in practical application.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Broadband Circularly Polarized Metasurface Antenna Using CMA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A low-profile wideband circularly polarized (CP) metasurface (MTS) antenna is proposed. The MTS consists of a set of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3^{\ast} 3$</tex> parallelograms like elements. The modal behavior of MTS is studied by using characteristic mode theory (CMA). The results show that mode 1 and mode 3 of MTS can realize wideband circular polarization. The proposed antenna size is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.45 \lambda_{0}\times 0.45 \lambda_{0}\times 0.065 \lambda_{0}$</tex>. The simulation results show that the 3dB axial ratio bandwidth is 6.0-7.1GHz, and the −10dB impedance bandwidth is 5.2-7.13GHz. The peak gain is 7.55dBi.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Environment of Shipborne Shortwave Antenna Based on Eastwave
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Short wave communication is one of the important means of ship communication, which can transmit voice, message and other information. Generally, the short wave antenna has a high transmission power, which often reaches hundreds or even thousands of watts. It is a high-power radiation source on ships, and its electromagnetic environmental effect can not be ignored. This paper simulates the electromagnetic environment formed by the shipborne shortwave antenna based on Eastwave software. It can provide some reference for the overall design of the ship.

articleTitle: Improvement and Implementation of IoT Device's Program Upgrade System on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: IoT terminal devices are characterized by a wide variety and wide distribution, and most devices are powered by batteries. Therefore, the requirements for the remote automatic upgrade program work of the device are more stringent. The program upgrade system of IoT terminal device based on cloud platform has become mature. However, there are still existing situations such as long upgrade time, low efficiency, and simple data encryption and decryption methods. The paper analyzes the functions and characteristics of the existing system, encrypts the uploaded upgrade files, and adjusts the data format of the protocol. The experimental results verify that the scheme can significantly improve the upgrade efficiency, reliability and other indicators.

articleTitle: Efficient Adaptive Beamforming of Underwater Acoustic Target under Impulsive Noise
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Underwater target detection is seriously affected by underwater impulse noise. In general, it is considered that the environmental noise follows Gaussian distribution. However, the underwater marine environmental noise data show that there is large impulse noise in underwater random noise, such as ice fracture in polar underwater environment and underwater impulse noise caused by iceberg collision and extrusion. At present, most beamforming methods are optimal in Gaussian environment noise, and their performance is greatly reduced in impulse noise environment. When the actual noise is impulse noise, the performance of conventional beamformer in impulse noise environment will be greatly reduced. To solve these problems, an adaptive beamforming method based on Andrew's sine estimator is proposed in this paper. The Andrew's sine function is a robust estimator, which has been used in outlier handling and robust statistics. However, such superior estimator does not receive attention in the field of adaptive beamforming. In this paper, a new variable parameter Andrew's sine estimator has been designed to improve performance. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed adaptive beamforming method still has good beamforming performance in impulse noise environment. And the proposed method has been compared with the traditional beamforming algorithms to verify its performance.

articleTitle: A Microwave CSRR Sensor for Non-Invasive Glucose-Level Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this letter, a microwave complementary split ring resonator (CSRR) sensor in the centimeter band for non-invasive glucose-level detection is introduced. The presented microwave sensor comprises four cells of triangle-shaped CSRRs, which is designed and fabricated on Rogers 6010LM dielectric substrate. The CSRR sensing cells are excited by electric field which is developed by the coupling from the microstrip line engraved on the bottom side of the dielectric substrate. A round plastic-made container is properly placed on the sensor area to hold the blood serum samples for measurements. Finally, the microwave sensor exhibits an excellent sensitivity for non-invasive glucose-level detection by the lab's survey applying a suitable VNA setup.

articleTitle: A Dual-band and Dual-polarization Multiplexed Reflective Metasurface Unit Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to achieve more multiplexing degrees, a dual-band and dual-polarization comprehensive multiplexing method is proposed in this paper. On this basis, a single reflective metasurface based on a cross-shaped resonator is proposed and simulated. The experimental results show that the designed unit cell can independently control the x and y polarized waves of 10GHz and 17GHz respectively, effectively isolate the two frequencies, and realize dual-band and dual-polarization multiplexing.

articleTitle: A Single-layer THz Wideband Reflectarray Antenna Using Snowflake Elements
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a snowflake-shaped element reflectarray antenna applied in THz communication frequency band is proposed. By employing this snowflake element, a 400° phase shift can be achieved in a single layer substrate at 100 GHz. A 19 × 19 beam deflection reflectarray is designed to verify this element. Simulation results show that the reflectarray has a beam deflection of 15° at 100 GHz. The measured gain is 25.4 dBi, and the measured 1-dB gain bandwidth is 15.6% with an aperture efficiency of 30.6%. Besides, a good directional radiation characteristics is also achieved.

articleTitle: Analysis and Mechanism of the Mutual Terrain Scattered Interference in Spaceborne SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Radio frequency interference (RFI) is a critical issue that leads to image degradation of spaceborne synthetic aperture radar (SAR) systems. In addition to the interference of ground terrestrial radiation sources, there is an emerging type of interference called mutual terrain scattered interference (MTSI), which is becoming more and more severe with the deployment of multiple satellite constellations. In this paper, we investigated the mechanism of MTSI, analyzed the signal characteristics, and discussed the boundary conditions from the time, frequency and space perspectives. Simulation results are provided for illustration, which provides a knowledge basis for interference detection and mitigation.

articleTitle: Configurable Universal QC-LDPC Encoder Architecture Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check (QC-LDPC) codes are widely used owning to its good performance and easy hardware implementation. However, most classical LDPC encoder designs do not support changing the LDPC code types or parameters according to different communication services and channel conditions. In this paper, we propose an encoder architecture with configurable code types, input information block lengths, coding rates and degrees of parallelism, which can realize “hot-switching” of configuration parameters. A new scheme that makes full use of the characteristics of the generation matrix is used in the core of parallel coding. The implementation on field programmable gate array (FPGA) shows that the throughput of the encoder can reach 1.6 Gbps under the condition of 7/8 coding rate (8176, 7154) and the degree of parallelism set to 8.

articleTitle: MCMC Based Bit-wise Detection for OTFS Modulation with Complexity Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) modulation as a promising signal representation attracts growing attention for integrated sensing and communication. This paper devotes to signal detection for OTFS system. Notice the characteristics of high dimension and sparsity of OTFS channel, we propose a bit-wise detector based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) method with reduced complexity. We simplify the Gibbs iteration process since the channel sparsity indicates that for a given transmitted symbol, only limited received symbols are associated with it, and vice versa. Simulations in various cases demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An Improved HWA Algorithm for Blind Recognition of Linear Block Codes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Hamming-Weight-Analysis (HWA) algorithm has the advantages of simple and fast, and can be widely used in code recognition. In this paper, we propose an improved HWA algorithm for blind recognition of linear block codes. The new algorithm effectively improves the recognition success rate and application scope of the HWA algorithm based on the idea of sliding-window filtering.

articleTitle: A Millimeter-Wave Dual-Polarized Filtering Patch Antenna Array Supported by High-Order SIW Cavity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A millimeter-wave dual-polarized 2 × 2 filtering patch antenna array with high polarization isolation, low cross-polarization level, high selectivity, and compact size is proposed in this paper. A high-order substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) cavity with four inside metallic via walls is proposed to support a 2 × 2 patch array with in-phase radiation and simplified feeding structure. The differentially-fed method is used to obtain a high polarization isolation. Filtering slots around the patches and the SIW cavity filters combined in the feeding lines are employed to improve the filtering performance. Simulated results indicate that the proposed array realizes a wide −10 dB impedance bandwidth of 8.8% from 27.22 to 29.70 GHz, a low cross-polarization level of 47 dB, a high polarization isolation above 50 dB, a flat in-band gain variation from 13.4 to 14.1 dBi, and high out of band suppression levels of 29 and 21 dB in the lower and upper stopbands, respectively.

articleTitle: Four-Port Reference MIMO Antenna for OTA Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reference antennas with different correlation coefficients for 4 × 4 multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems are investigated in this paper. Two types of reference antennas are designed, i.e., bad reference antenna with high correlations (HC) and good reference antenna with low correlations (LC). The correlations are controlled by changing the orientation of the elements of the reference antenna. By using the reference antennas with known performances, the unknown antenna effects can be eliminated, which is vital for experimental verification of over-the-air (OTA) testing solutions. Moreover, in order to have a good matching and isolation between the antenna elements, impedance matching method and decoupling scheme are applied during the design process of the reference antennas.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromagnetic Properties from Time-Varying Moving Plasma with Lorentz-FDTD
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: During flight of hypersonic vehicle, a layer of plasma sheath will be formed around the aircraft due to the high temperature. As the results of turbulence, the plasma sheath is time-varying. In addition, the hypersonic vehicle and plasma sheath keeps a high-speed relative motion with the radar on the ground. The plasma sheath will influence the original electromagnetic scattering properties of the aircraft, which will affect the normal observation of the aircraft from the radar. Therefore, it is significant to study the interaction between plasma sheaths and electromagnetic wave. In this paper, Lorentz-FDTD (Finite-Difference Time-Domain) method is used to analyze the electromagnetic properties of time-varying plasma sheaths in a 2-D case, and the result show that the time-varying and moving plasma will modulate the electromagnetic waves.

articleTitle: Adaptive Subspace Classification Technique Using Fuzzy Support Vector Machine for Supspace-based TOA Estimation in a Multipath Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive subspace classification technique using a fuzzy support vector machine (FSVM) is proposed for subspace-based TOA estimation in a multipath channel. For the subspace-based algorithm to work properly, the signal subspace should be correctly estimated from a data matrix composed of the received samples. Through SVD on the data matrix, singular values and vectors are derived in pairs. According to the derived singular values, the corresponding singular vectors are selected as a set of basis-spanning signal subspaces. Criteria such as the Akaike information criterion (AIC) and minimum description length criterion (MDLC) have previously been adopted for subspace classification. Instead of using these criteria, we propose an adaptive classification technique using a FSVM for improved subspace-based TOA estimation in a multipath channel.

articleTitle: A Low-profile Wideband Dual-Polarized Omnidirectional Antenna for 2G/3G/LTE/Sub-6G Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A low-profile wideband dual-polarized omnidirectional antenna is designed for 2G/3G/LTE/sub-6G technologies. The dual-polarized antenna consists of two parts, i.e., a vertically polarized tapered gradient monopole and a horizontally polarized connected Vivaldi antenna array. The horizontal polarization (HP) element is designed as the metal ground of the vertical polarization (VP) element to avoid match deterioration when the HP element is positioned closely to the metal ground of the VP element. Thus, the dual-polarized antenna realizes an extremely low profile of 0.07 λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</inf> (λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</inf> is the wavelength at the minimum frequency in the operational band). The designed antenna achieves an overlapping bandwidth of 1.7-8 GHz (130%) and an isolation higher than 20dB within the band. In the azimuth plane the simulated gain changes less than 3dB for both VP and HP elements within the operating band.

articleTitle: Coexistence strategy of nuclear power equipment and wireless communication technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The introduction of wireless communication technology in nuclear power plants faces challenges, although it can improve productivity and save cable costs. Firstly, wireless communication signals may cause electromagnetic noise interference to existing nuclear power equipment, and radio wave monitoring can lead to information leakage. Secondly, nuclear power plant equipment also generates noise in the working frequency band of wireless equipment, which affects its communication quality. Based on existing standards and test results, this paper discusses strategy about how nuclear power equipment and wireless technologies can coexist, and proposes recommendations to avoid mutual interference.

articleTitle: A Step size Converter for Normalized Subband Adaptive Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The normalized subband adaptive filter (NSAF) algorithm converges rapidly in highly correlated input scenarios, but it also exists a performance compromise which is caused by the constant step-size. To effectively deal with this drawback, we design a step-size converter (SSC) according to the second-order theoretical behavior of NSAF and then develop the SSC-NSAF algorithm. The proposed approach can select the most appropriate step-size for the next iteration by comparing the mean-square deviations of the NSAF algorithm with given different step-sizes. Simulations have verified the superiority of the proposed algorithm as compared to the existing counterparts.

articleTitle: Design of X-band Ultra-wide-angle Scanning Phased Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to realize the ultra-wide angle scanning of X-band, a new design of tightly coupled array antenna unit is proposed, and combined with the equivalent circuit analysis. With the integrated Marchand balun, the dipole and balun can be printed on the same PCB, thereby reducing the weight and cost of the antenna. The vertical parasitic superstrate and horizontal dielectric layer are loaded on the antenna aperture to improve the impedance matching when the antenna is scanned at a large angle. The simulation results show that the antenna can achieve a scanning angle of 80° on the E-plane and 70° on the H-plane in the X-band (8–12 GHz), with acitive VSWR< 3. The antenna has a simple structure, a low profile, and is easy to process.

articleTitle: A Low-profile Anti-interference Dual-Port Pattern Reconfigurable Monopole Antenna For 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper provides a dual-port printed monopole antenna with pattern reconfigurable anti-interference feature. By controlling the PIN diodes corresponding to the two modes of differential mode and common mode, the current flows through two different paths. The antennas are realized in the same frequency band with approximately complementary radiation patterns. This allows switching between two different scenarios subject to or not subject to interference for anti-interference. The proposed antenna is well designed and carefully investigated using simulation software. The simulation results show that the antenna has pattern reconfigurable anti-interference characteristics and is expected to be used for 5G wireless communication applications.

articleTitle: Decoupling Method of MIMO Antenna Using Metal-graphene Composite Branch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a graphene-based composite decoupling structure is proposed. Firstly, an inverted U-shaped decoupling branch based on the equivalent circuit principle of space field coupling is proposed to improve the isolation between array antenna units in dual-polarization directions. Then, a 2×2 MIMO antenna array is designed to verify the effect of the proposed decoupling structure. The simulation results show the decoupling structure operates at 2.5 GHz ~2.65 GHz, and the isolation of the array antenna increases 10dB compared with that without the decoupling structure.

articleTitle: Long-time Integration for Drone targets Detection Based on Digital Ubiquitous Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: “Low (low altitude), slow (slow maneuvering) and small (small size)” targets such as drones pose a serious threat to airport flight safety and urban security, and there is an urgent need for effective detection. These targets have weak echoes and inconspicuous features, covered by strong clutter. Conventional radar data update rates are low with limited integration pulses, making detection extremely difficult. In this paper, the digital ubiquitous radar is used for long-time observation in order to improve the detection performance, and the high-order motion characteristics of low-altitude drone target are analyzed. The long-time integration method is proposed via Keystone transform (KT) and the enhanced fractional Fourier transform (EFRFT) to compensate the range and Doppler migrations simultaneously. Both simulation and real experiment using L-band digital ubiquitous radar are carried out to verify the performance of the proposed method. It is shown that the integration ability is better and the peak spectrum are more obvious compared with the traditional FFT-based moving target detection (MTD) and popular FRFT method.

articleTitle: A Low Side-lobe Waveguide Antenna Integrated with Solar Cell Using Non-offset Slots
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a ridge waveguide antenna integrated with solar cell using non-offset slots. This waveguide antenna has 8 radiation slots, each radiation slot is placed like a straight line on the centerline of the broad side of the waveguide and a metal pin is arranged on one side of the slot in the waveguide to excite electromagnetic wave radiation. Low sidelobe is achieved by adjusting the length of the metal pins. Two rectangle solar cells are arranged on both sides of the slots. The scanning VSWR of the antenna is less than 1.7 at 9.6GHz~9.8GHz, the maximum gain is about 14.45dBi and the side lobe level is less than -25dB. Moreover, the introduction of solar cells has little effect on the antenna performance.

articleTitle: An Interaction Framework for Multi-domain Unmanned Systems Collaboration Based on Interoperability Messages
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To improve the interoperability of unmanned system and enhance the multi-domain unmanned system collaborative capacity, we propose an interaction framework based on interoperability messages, which consists of a set of message standard and the correlated interaction protocol. Combines the common information interaction requirements of unmanned system and the different specificity of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), unmanned surface vehicles (USV), unmanned ground vehicles (UGV), unmanned underwater vehicles (UUV) and the corresponding payloads carried by the unmanned systems, the message standard set can be divided into three main categories, each category contains several kinds of message. The interaction protocol of a message varies according to the message's type and meaning. The interaction framework will help human operator make it easier to control different kinds of multi-domain unmanned systems and make autonomous cooperative between unmanned systems possible.

articleTitle: Research on Networking Technology based on BLE Mesh
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent light control system based on TLSR8258 module is evaluated. The devices communicate with each other through the Bluetooth Low Energy(BLE) mesh network, and the system connects to WiFi through the ESP32 module in the Bluetooth gateway to make the mesh network connect to the Internet. The user can use application or the MQTT client to communicate with the Bluetooth gateway to monitor the light status of devices. A five-device-demo system with mobile app and web frontend is developed and the end-to-end delay time and packet delivery ratio (PDR) to test network performance of this system are evaluated. We test the two different BLE mesh setup to find which cross-layer configuration is better for. It is shown that the PDR of telink mesh is 16% higher than that of sig mesh, average end-to-end delay of sig mesh is slight less than telink mesh within 150ms.

articleTitle: Broad- and Narrow-band Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna for Cognitive Radio Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to improve spectrum utilization, a broad-and narrow-band frequency reconfigurable antenna for cognitive radio systems is presented in this paper. The antenna radiation patch is composed of two semicircles with different radii. The spiral slit is etched into a cut-angle rectangle ground plane, allowing the antenna to operate in narrow bands. Two PIN diodes are loaded in the slit, and their on/off states are controlled by the DC bias circuit on the front of the substrate. So that the resonant length of the slit is varied to achieve frequency reconfigurable. The simulation results show that the antenna can operate in three states, UWB: 3.82-12GHz, single band: 3.02-4.40GHz, dual band: 3.05-4.16GHz and 6.23-7.20GHz. The designed antenna has simple structure, small size (19×17.5×0.787mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) and good radiation performance.

articleTitle: Improved Zero-Attracting LMS Algorithm for the Adaptive Identification of Sparse System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The ZA-LMS (Zero-Attraction Least Mean Square) algorithm is an efficient sparse system identification algorithm. The core of it is to exert attraction on the weight coefficients in the process of iteration to make the error close to zero as far as possible. However, if the weight coefficients are applied with the same attraction, it leads to the slow convergence of the algorithm due to the insufficient attraction when the weight coefficient is close to zero. And when the weight coefficient is large, the steady-state error of the algorithm will increase due to the immoderate pressure applied. At the same time, the fixed step size and regularization parameter make it difficult for the algorithm to maintain a suitable trade-off between the steady state error and the fixed step size. Therefore, considering the aspects of the attraction operator, step size, and regularization parameter, an improved algorithm named VP-LZA-LMS (Variable Parameters and Logarithmic function based ZA-LMS) is suggested in this essay. Firstly, the original penalty term in ZA-LMS is changed using the logarithmic function, and then a new weight updating equation is derived, which enables the algorithm to exert different attractive force according to the value of the coefficient during updating. Secondly, on the basis of the reduced mean square deviation, new formulas are created that allow the step size and regularization parameter to be changed in real time in line with the error. The imbalance between the steady state error and the convergence rate is alleviated by the step size and regularization parameter's variability. Finally, simulation findings demonstrate that the suggested VP-LZA-LMS algorithm outperforms some existing similar algorithms in terms of convergence and tracking performance under the condition of white and colored input

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 77G Radar System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Millimeter-wave radar sensors have the advantages of all-weather, all-day and other advantages. They have been used in aircraft and ship navigation from the early stage of research and development, and have gradually been widely used in automobiles. This paper designs a millimeter-wave radar system scheme based on the AWR1243+MUC+FPGA platform. Firstly, the external MUC is used to configure the parameters of each part of the AWR1243 chip through SPI to realize the startup of the chip. Then, through the realization of MIPI CSI-2 interface, the sampling data of radar intermediate frequency signal is extracted. Finally, according to the obtained radar data, the basic principle of frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar ranging, speed and angle measurement is studied, the radar target is detected by the two-dimensional constant false alarm algorithm, and the two-dimensional constant false alarm detection is detected by the method of point trace aggregation. The obtained radar target is reprocessed to obtain an accurate radar target.

articleTitle: Design of Microstrip-Based Power Combiner /Divider for 700MHz-960MHz Band
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a microstrip power combiner /divider with low insertion loss and high isolation operated in 700–790 MHz and 885–960 MHz bands is presented. The insertion loss and isolation between two bands can be controlled by L-shaped branch independently. Impedance matching can be further improved by the influence of fan-shaped patch. The power combiner's insertion loss is lower than 0.4 dB and the return loss is lower than −15 dB (VSWR<1.5) in the passband. The port isolation level is better than 15 dB across the desired bands.

articleTitle: Link 16 Message Processing Based on Transaction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Data link is a key factor for achieving interoperability of combat units to enhance operational capability in modern net-centric operations. Aiming at improving the interoperability between combat units, we propose a general message processing mechanism and construct a transaction based model. Taking a typical function of link 16 for example, the proposed method of message processing is illustrated. Experiment results demonstrate that the transaction based method is able to realize standardization of message processing. Besides, the reachability, coverability and completeness of processing are verified via the executable Petri net model analysis.

articleTitle: A L2 Band LHCP Antenna with Combination of Unequal Slots and Arc-Shaped Protruding Patches
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A microstrip circular polarization (CP) patch antenna with a combination of unequal slots and arc-shaped protruding patches is proposed and designed, which can work for L2 band of GPS. The antenna is composed of ground plane, dielectric and radiation patch, where two unequal slots and arc-shaped protruding patches are loaded on the patch and placed along the diagonal. By adjusting the radius of arc-shape slots and protruding patches, Left-handed circular polarization (LHCP) is realized. Simulation and optimization results show that the CP antenna achieves axial ratio bandwidth of 10MHz and impedance bandwidth of 40MHz, providing a potential application for GPS.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Circularly-Polarized SIW Antenna Array Using High-Order Modes in Ka-Band
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-band circularly-polarized (CP) antenna array based on the substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) in Ka-band is present in this paper. The antenna is consisted of SIW resonant cavity with slots and SIW feeding network. By using TM130 and TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">230</inf> modes, a dual-band linearly-polarized antenna can be achieved. In 2×2 antenna subarray, CP characteristic is achieved by sequential rotation technique (SRT). For the sake of improving the directivity, a 4×4 antenna array with good performance is achieved. Finally, the antenna array achieved the operating bands of 27.50-27.83 GHz and 30.33-30.54 GHz, 3-dB axial ration (AR) bandwidths of 27.68-27.75 GHz and 30.45-30.51 GHz, and peak gains of 18.0 dBi and 17.6 dBi, respectively. Due to the advantages of high gain and circular polarization, the design can be applied for millimeter-Wave (mm-Wave) satellite communication systems.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Energy IoT Data Trusted Collection and Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With continuous upgrading of energy types and information technologies, the energy Internet of Things (IoT) presents a trend of distribution, intelligence and integration, which inevitably generates massive and diverse energy data. These data are dispatched by different parties in the process of generation, transmission, storage and usage. The data also cause a large number of security risks such as data loss, theft, and tampering easily. In this paper, we propose a blockchain-based energy IoT data trusted collection and transmission technology to improve the security and reliability of the energy IoT. We use consortium blockchain technology to achieve energy data management monitoring. To reduce block storage pressure, only energy collection process are recorded in the block, meanwhile the original data are stored off the block. Finally, we build a simulation platform in Python environment to verify the feasibility of our proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Missing Data Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on SVT-1DCNN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Missing data is a common phenomenon in induction motor fault datasets, which could lead to a loss of statistical ability and/or biased results for fault diagnosis. In this paper, we address the rolling bearing fault diagnosis in the presence of missing data, where a bearing fault diagnosis method based on singular value thresholding (SVT) low-rank matrix filling and one-dimension convolutional neural network (1DCNN) is proposed. Specifically, the SVT low-rank matrix filling is first used to recover the missing fault bearing data, and then 1DCNN is adopted to extract the fault feature and classify each fault automatically. The experimental results show that the classification accuracy of the proposed method can be promoted as high as 96.38%, which is better than that of other methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Fast Fault Identification Method of Gearbox in Satellite TT & C System Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper aims at the problem of fault identification in the operation of Satellite TT & C system equipment, taking the fault identification of reducer, which is the core function driving the normal operation of Satellite TT & C system, as an example, and puts forward a rapid fault identification method of Satellite TT & C system equipment based on Bayesian network. The research takes the inference model of Bayesian network dealing with uncertain problems as the basic model, combined with the analysis of the fault principle and historical fault samples of Satellite TT & C system equipment, establishes the Bayesian inference model based on the fault tree, and integrates the fault statistical data into the model in the form of conditional probability, so as to realize the rapid diagnosis, location and identification of Satellite TT & C system equipment faults. The verification results of the gearbox fault identification of the actual on orbit satellite TT & C system show that this method can quickly and effectively identify the faults of the satellite TT & C system equipment, effectively improve the reliability of the on orbit satellite TT & C system equipment, and is of great significance to ensure the long-term safe operation of the on orbit satellite.
