abstract: Channel estimation is critical and challenging for millimeter-wave (mmWave) massive multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems. In this paper, the quantum mechanics denoising (QMD)-based algorithm and the orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP)-based algorithm are combined for channel estimation. The proposed QMDOMP-based algorithm has two parts. The first part is to denoise the received signal by using the QMD-based algorithm. Firstly, according to the received signal, the Hamiltonian matrix is constructed and the corresponding eigenvalues and eigenvectors are calculated. Then, the coefficients are calculated by projecting the received signal onto the adaptive basis. Using the soft threshold processing of coefficients, the denoised received signal is reconstructed. The second part is that the denoised received signal uses the OMP-based algorithm for channel estimation. In each iteration, the correlation between the sensing matrix and the residual signal is obtained. Then, the greatest correlation column of the sensing matrix is selected to update the residual. After several iterations, the selected atoms form a support set. Simulation results show that the proposed QMDOMP-based algorithm shows better estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Unknown Radar Signal Recognition Method Based on SER Block and Semi-Hard Triplet Loss
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To solve the problem of misclassification about unknown radar categories, a method based on squeeze and excitation residual block (SER Block) and semi-hard triplet loss is proposed in this paper. First, the known radar signal is preprocessed to obtain its time-frequency images (TFIs). Second, the TFIs of the known radar signal is mapped to the 128-dimensional embedding space through the network built based on the SER Block. At the same time, use the semi-hard triplet loss function to adjust the network parameters, so that the signals of the same kind are more concentrated and the signals between classes are more dispersed in the embedded space. Finally, a method based on distance threshold is used to distinguish the unknown radar signals accurately, and to ensure the correct classification of the known radar signals. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of unknown radar signals is more than 89% at −8db, and that of known radar signals is more than 95%.

articleTitle: Micro-motion Feature Extraction of Space Target Based on Parametric Sparse Representation with Incoherence Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The micro-motion feature of space targets provide important information for automatic radar target recognition. However, with the existing micro-motion feature extraction methods, the coherence of echo signals is required, which is hard to be met in the practical. Therefore, aimed at the incoherence echo signals, a novel micro-motion feature extraction method based on parametric sparse representation is proposed in this paper. By making use of the Doppler sensitivity of the kind of signals which consist of several sub-pulses with stepped frequency, the instantaneous velocity of each scatters of the target can be estimated via parametric sparse representation, and then the micro-motion feature parameters can be extracted via fitting the obtained instantaneous velocity according to the mathematical expression of m-D effect. Simulations are given to validate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Unknown Protocol Classification Method based on Clustering Algorithm and Hyperparametric Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of Internet communication and satellite communication, and other fields, the number of network protocol types has gradually increased, which contains a large number of private protocols or unknown protocols, which makes the network management and maintenance work increasingly heavy and very difficult. To address this problem, we proposed a classification method of unknown protocols. By preprocessing, feature extraction, and clustering method based on hyperparametric optimization scheme, two classes of classifiers are constructed to classify and identify the unknown protocol data to meet the actual business requirements. The experimental results show that the improved optimization method has a 4.6% increase in the mean probability of obtaining the global optimal solution compared with the traditional optimization method, and the proposed method can effectively identify and classify the protocols.

articleTitle: Research on Auxiliary Detection Technology for Downlink Telemetry Parameter Anomaly Discovery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of efficient and automatic identification for the anomaly detection of carrier rocket downlink telemetry parameters, an automatic identification method based on the statistical characteristics of historical data is proposed for the slowly varying parameters. Under the condition of time slicing, the method first performs numerical filtering on historical measured data, and then Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) algorithm is used to locally model the segmented historical data. Secondly, the prediction output of the GPR sub-model based on each historical sample data is fused by the dynamic Gauss-Markov estimation algorithm to obtain the prediction value and prediction variance of the target data, and the parameter discrimination interval is constructed based on this. The real-time abnormal alarm is given when the statistical distribution of the measured target data of each sub segment in the discrimination interval exceeds the limit. Finally, after accumulating the complete and effective data segments of the measured parameters of the target, the global distribution is counted, and if it exceeds the limit, the parameter abnormality flag is given. Simulation results show that this method can effectively find abnormal parameters, and has strong ability to suppress random noise and more accurate parameter estimation ability.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Analysis Method for Real-time Operating System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Worst-case Execution Time (WCET) represents the Execution Time of a program in the worst-case scenario, the WCET of each RTOS module has a great influence on the real-time performance of the operating system. Most of the existing evaluation methods of RTOS real-time performance are to select several specific indicators and obtain the time value by using the test-based method, which cannot guarantee the security of the obtained execution time. Therefore, this paper firstly studies the key technologies of WCET analysis, and then designs and implements a static WCET analysis tool based on the open source tool Chronos from three aspects: the transplantation of ARM instruction set, the parsing of ELF files, and the modeling and analysis of microarchitecture model. WCET analysis of some key time indicators of mginkgo microkernel operating system was carried out by using this analysis tool, and the safe execution time of some key modules were obtained. The static WCET analysis tool designed in this paper can analyze the executable file of ARM instruction set and get its worst-case execution time estimate, which has certain universality.

articleTitle: Broadband Dielectric Characterization of Textile Materials for Clothing Antenna Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A broadband dielectric characterization of textile fabrics for clothing antenna designs is presented in this paper. The dielectric properties of four types of textile fabrics were investigated, where the measurements of complex permittivity were undertaken from 0.5 to 20 GHz. Frequency dispersion of these properties were also examined with standard deviations.

articleTitle: Improved 555 Multivibrator to Measure Degradable Supercapacitive Pressure Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Capacitive pressure sensor has been widely used and developed due to its high sensitivity, fast response and good mechanical robustness. In order to design a degradable supercapacitive pressure sensor, a practical pressure measuring device was developed by using 555 multivibrator and STM32. The sensor adopts supercapacitor structure, uses 555 timer multivibrator circuit as sensor detection circuit, STM32 as precision output control module, which can quickly and accurately convert capacitance signal into frequency signal. In addition, in the low voltage range (< 250 Pa), the sensitivity is 1.63 kPa-1, and the fast response time of 45 ms can be achieved. It has the advantages of small volume, low power consumption and digital signal output.

articleTitle: Research on Linearization Technology of Power Amplifier Based on Digital Predistortion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: High-frequency power amplifier, as a key device in wireless communication system, its inherent nonlinearity and memory characteristics lead to spectrum spread, signal distortion when faced with signals with larger bandwidths and higher peak-to-average ratios, which seriously affects the communication quality. Traditional power amplifier linearization techniques, such as feed-forward method and power back-off method, have problems such as being difficult to implement, difficult to adjust and inefficient. Based on the current hot-discussed digital pre-distortion technology, this paper pre-compensates the distortion characteristics of the power amplifier at the baseband. The simulation shows that this method can effectively improve the linear characteristics of the power amplifier. At the same time, due to the offline adaptive learning method, it also has stronger flexibility and adjustability, and can adapt to the influence of changes in the environment, temperature, etc. on the power amplifier.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design Strategy on the Older People's Use Vitality of Community Garden
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to analyze the relationship between the perception and the use intensity of community garden for the aged, two cases including Area de Lazer do Edificio Lok Yeong Fa Yuen and Praca Das Orquideas are compared in terms of empty spaces, fitness equipment, shadow, rich in species, privacy, traffic noise, children's activities. Then, the design suggestions and elements are proposed, and hence the community garden can be designed and governed well for the aged in the high density area.

articleTitle: Analysis of 5G Power Control Mechanism for PUSCH: from 3GPP Standard Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, 5G power control mechanism for PUSCH is analyzed from 3GPP standard perspective. Then, considering practical PUSCH scheduling cases, detailed illustrations and analysis are provided for potential closed-loop power control schemes when joint channel estimation across multi-slot is enabled. After the analysis, it can be known that the interlacing between CG-PUSCH and DG-PUSCH transmission may cause closed-loop power control issues. In the end, two potential methods which may deal with these issues are analyzed.

articleTitle: Parallel Implementation Of Clutter Suppression Of Passive Radar Based On LDLT
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the increasing signal bandwidth of oppor-tunistic radiators, real-time clutter suppression has become a serious challenge for passive radars. To solve the problem, this paper designs an inter-segment parallel algorithm based on the extended cancellation algorithm batches (ECA-B) of LDLT decomposition. Firstly, based on the GPU multi-thread parallel processing technology, the effectiveness of the ECA-B algorithm is improved by segmented parallel processing, which is combined with the same sub-module characteristics of each segment of the ECA-B algorithm. Then, the cost of the time of data transmission in the inversion process of traditional ECA-B algorithm is economized by proposing a parallel iterative inversion method based on LDLT leveraging the conjugate symmetry property of covariance matrix, which is processed by two CUDA kernel function and further improves the execution efficiency of the parallel algorithm between segments. Experimental results show that the algorithm performs higher effectiveness compared with the traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Degree of Freedom of A MIMO Communication System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Compared with a single-input-single-output (SISO) communication system, the benefit of multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) technology originates from its extra degree of freedom (DOF), also referred as scattering channels or spatial electromagnetic (EM) modes. As DOF has clear physical meaning, it is essential to model the DOF from EM perspective, other than using the classical empirical models. Here, we demonstrate an EM channel model for the DOF analyses of MIMO systems in arbitrary certain environments. Moreover, two numerical examples are given, including the free-space near-field communications and the key-hole communications.

articleTitle: A Filtering Dipole Antenna with Reconfigurable Frequency and Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A filtering dipole antenna is designed in this paper. Two symmetric inverted L microstrip lines form a dipole structure, and the parasitic microstrip line and the loaded open circuit branch introduce two radiation zeros, which make the antenna produce filtering response. The frequency and bandwidth can be reconstructed by controlling the radiation zero of the filtering dipole antenna with variable capacitance. The center frequency of the antenna can be shifted from 2. 3 GHz to 2.6 GHz, and the working bandwidth can be expanded from 200 MHz to 600 MHz, which can maintain good filtering performance during antenna reconstruction.

articleTitle: Variable Order Modeling and Parameter Identification based on Lithium iron Phosphate Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the low approximation degree of low-order model and the complex structure of high-order model existing in the current equivalent circuit model of lithium-ion battery for vehicles, a variable order equivalent circuit model of power battery was established based on the RC model to solve the contradiction between the accuracy and practicability of the battery model. Firstly, the characteristics of lithium iron phosphate batteries commonly used in electric vehicles were analyzed. The resistance and capacity identification was carried out according to the model characteristics. The order identification was carried out using Akaike Information Criterion (AIC). The final simulation results show that the accuracy error of the model is stable within 12mV, and the error stability is high, demonstrating the superiority of the model.

articleTitle: Outer Synchronization of Fractional-Order Complex-Valued Multiple Weights Networks with Coupling Delay
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we study the outer synchronization of fractional-order complex-valued networks (CDNs) through an adaptive control strategy. The multiple weights networks and coupling time delay are considered in the mode, which makes the system more in line with the actual situation. Using fractional Lyapunov stability theorem and the fractional-order time delay inequality, we obtain sufficient conditions for the network to reach the outer synchronization. The obtained results apply to both single weight networks and multiple weights networks. Finally, the Lorentz and Chen system is used to verify numerical simulations to demonstrate the validity of the theoretical derivation.

articleTitle: Design of 2.3~3.7GHz Broadband Hybrid Continuous Class F Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, on the basis of class F power amplifier, a hybrid continuous class F power amplifier theory is given for the problem of too narrow operating bandwidth of class F power amplifier. The impedance solution space based on this theory is more extensive compared to class F power amplifiers, and the bandwidth is greatly extended at the expense of certain efficiency. According to the theory, a hybrid continuous class F power amplifier with an operating frequency of 2.3~3.7GHz and a relative bandwidth of 46.7% has been designed, and the actual test results show that the range of power added efficiency is 62% ~ 80%, the gain is 11~13dB, and the maximum output power is more than 10W, which has good practical engineering application value.

articleTitle: A Gong-Si-Shaped Heterogeneous Circular-Polarization Array for 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, a Gong-Si-shaped circularly polarized (CP) array with power driver for 5G is proposed. The radiator of the constructed CP array consists of two Chinese-like characters “ and “” with the similar size and pronunciation of “gong” and “si”, Two L-shaped feeding probes of the same size are connected to the designed power driver printed on the bottom layer of ground plate, and the array can radiate circular polarization electromagnetic waves by changing the positions of the L-shaped probes and the angle of the horizontal parts of the L-shaped probes. From the simulating and optimizing, it is finally obtained that the −15 dB bandwidth of modeled Gong-Si-like CP antenna lies in 2.49 –– 2.81 GHz and the presented Gong-Si-like CP antenna has a axial bandwidth covering 2.36 –– 2.82 GHz, which meets the n41 5G band implementing at 2.515 –– 2.675 GHz.

articleTitle: Design of A Dual-Band Circularly Polarized Phased Array Using Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A circularly polarized phased array is proposed and analyzed at 28 and 38 GHz for 5G communications. Radiations of the antenna element in the two bands are realized by four annular slots and four rectangular slots etched on a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) cavity. Broadside radiation patterns in two frequency bands are investigated by characteristic mode analysis (CMA), and the circular polarization is realized by exciting a pair of orthogonal modes with a phase difference of 90° and an identical amplitude. The simulation results show that the -10dB impedance bandwidths of the antenna element are 26.1-29.4 and 36.2-39.1 GHz. Then an array configuration of 2×2 elements is designed to realize the beam scanning capability under excitations with different phase shifts. In the simulation, the broadside realized gains of the right-handed circular polarization are 10.4 and 12.5 dBi in the low and high bands, respectively. The maximum scanning angles of the 2×2 phased array are ±30° and ±25° in the low and high bands, respectively.

articleTitle: Design of Radome Based on Multi-layer Structure with Wide Transmission Band
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The radome is an important component of the antenna system. With the widening of the working frequency band of the antenna, the radome also needs to have the characteristics of wide transmission band, which puts forward higher requirements for the optimization design of the radome. In this paper, the design of radome with a broad passband is realized based on the multilayer structure. First, the transmission characteristics of the multilayer dielectric layer structure are analyzed by using the equivalent transmission line theory, and then the multi-layer structure is optimized and simulated by 3D electromagnetic simulation software. Finally, the design of a wide transmission band radome with oblique incidence stability is realized.

articleTitle: S2D Behavioral Model for Limiter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: At present, there are few studies describing the external characteristics of limiters, and there is a lack of low-cost modeling solutions. In order to solve this problem, this paper simulates the power-related <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S$</tex> -parameters in the limiting circuit, extracts its S2D model, and analyzes the model error. Compared with the simulation results of the cascaded limiter and amplifier circuit, the gain error using the S2D model and the amplifier circuit consists of the S2D model error and the inter-stage matching error, and both errors will gradually increase as the input power increases. Therefore, the S2D model of the limiter can only accurately describe the linear region and state of the circuit when it is clipped, but it can be used in receiver design.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based AP Selection Method in Software-defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the Software Defined Network (SDN), the terminal has been connected to the network in the process when an access point failure or damage, if the access point is not properly selected, it will lead to a decline in the quality of service applications. To address this problem, most traditional AP selection methods use access point selection based on received signal strength without take into account the channel and channel capacity of the access point access, while this paper uses Deep Neural Networks (DNN)-based access point (AP) selection method and considers the channel and channel capacity as part of the parameters. In the SDN controller, the received signal strength, throughput, number of connected devices, channel, and the channel capacity and access point performance quality are used as the input and label of the DNN, respectively. The analysis and simulation results show that the algorithm can select AP with better performance quality compared with the traditional AP selection method based on received signal strength, and the correct rate is significantly improved by 5% when compared with the AP selection method based on feedforward neural network. Meanwhile, the DNN-based access point selection method in SDN achieves flexible control of network traffic and balances the load of access points in the network.

articleTitle: Design of a Dielectric Lens Antenna with the Similar Shape of Half Maxwell Fish-Eye (HMFE)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a dielectric lens antenna with the similar shape of half Maxwell fish-eye (HMFE) lens is presented in LTE band (1.71-2.7GHz). The antenna is realized by piling up the dielectric materials with different sizes, which contains a number of cylindrical air holes by the rule of getting smaller from antenna edge to center. With the distribution of aforementioned air holes in dielectric materials, a gradient variation trend of effective permittivity is built in both the horizontal and vertical planes. As a result, the electromagnetic wave can be transformed from spherical wave to plane wave, and finally achieves high-gain performance. Simulation results of far-field plots demonstrate good focusing properties of the proposed dielectric lens antenna. Moreover, its light weight, low cost, and easy fabrication makes it well suited for modern wireless communication system.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-Thin Metamaterial Absorber Based on Resistive Film Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-thin metamaterial absorber loaded with resistive film is proposed to achieve polarization and angular insensitive absorption characteristics in a large incident range. The proposed absorber contains three layers. The top layer is the metal covered by the circular resistance film, the middle layer is the dielectric material, and the bottom layer is the metal ground. The proposed absorber can achieve above 20% absorption rate from 8 to 40 GHz, which is of great significance in the field of electromagnetic stealth.

articleTitle: Single-Layer Single-Polarization Rectifying Surface for Microwave Wireless Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a single-layer single-polarization rectifying surface for microwave wireless power transfer is proposed. The proposed periodic rectifying surface cell is composed of integrated receiving metal structure and Schottky diode. Firstly, the diode's equivalent impedance is obtained by simulation. Then, the rectifying surface unit cell metal structure is properly designed to be directly matched to the diode impedance without extra matching circuit. Adjacent periodic cells are connected together by the unit cell's arms to form a series connected DC structure. Thus, only a single layer is required for the rectifying surface design. To verify the design concept, a 5 × 10 array is fabricated and measured. Experimental results show that the proposed structure can produce 228 mW DC power at 2.45 GHz under normal incident power density of 1.1324 mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> when the load is 950 Ω. The proposed rectifying surface has the potential to be applied in a microwave wireless power transfer system.

articleTitle: Plasma Parameter Inversion Base on Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As a dispersive medium, plasma has broad application prospects in stealth antenna and new attenuator design. Plasma parameters, such as electron density and collision frequency, are the basis for studying plasma property. At present, conventional plasma parameter inversion algorithms encounter some difficulties, such as large amount of calculation, long inversion time, low inversion accuracy. A deep learning model for plasma parameter inversion is proposed in this paper. The model takes full advantage of the characteristics of deep neural network, with simple structure, fast operation speed. And the plasma parameters can be reconstructed with high precision. The simulation results indicate that the inversion results are better than traditional methods even in the presence of noise.

articleTitle: The parameter Estimation of Monostatic FDA-MIMO radar based on Unitary ESPRIT algorithm under mutual coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel unitary estimation of signal parameter via rotation invariance technique (ESPRIT) to eliminate mutual coupling based on the joint DOA-range estimation of Monostatic frequency diverse array multiple-input multiple-output radar (FDA-MIMO). Firstly, the selection matrix is designed to remove the mutual coupling by using the banded and symmetric Toeplitz property of the transmitting and receiving mutual coupling matrix. Then, the extended real-valued data is constructed by using the middle Hermite property of the received data, and the accuracy of the estimation is improved and the computational complexity is reduced by unitary transformation. Finally, we estimate the parameter of the target by using the rotation invariance of the array. The simulation proves the superiority and validity of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation and ZigBee Smart Home Device Security Access Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a secure access method for Zigbee networks. Install Code is used to pre-configure the entry key when a smart device is connecting to a Zigbee network, thus guaranteeing the security of ZigBee entry and entry efficiency. The hardware based experiment results show that using Install Code encryption in the network has a better defence against sniffing attacks, and has 5% lower packet loss rate compared to Global key entry.

articleTitle: A Fractional-Order Chaotic System and its Image Encryption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Many researchers have worked on image encryption combined with chaotic systems, and have made significant progress in recent decades. A fractional-order memristive chaotic systemr is proposed in this paper. Through theoretical analysis and numerical simulation, we found that the system has hidden attractors and coexistence behavior. Other than that, because the chaotic sequence generated by the chaotic system has a large key space and high security, an image encryption scheme is presented based on the chaotic system. We verify the effectiveness of the encryption method proposed in this paper by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A Patch-fed Wideband Dual-polarized Terahertz Horn Antenna Based on Quartz Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A patch-fed wideband dual-polarized Terahertz (THz) horn antenna is presented in this paper. By stacking etched quartz substrates to form a stepped cavity, an air-filled horn is realized. A dual-polarized broadband patch feed coupled with H-shaped slots is used to excite the horn. According to our simulation results, the proposed antenna could achieve −10dB-level fractional impedance bandwidth of around 19.5% and reach a peak gain of 13.2 dBi from 182 to 222 GHz. The antenna realizes a port isolation more than 25dB as well as broadband polarization isolation of more than 23dB.

articleTitle: Electrical Performance Analysis of Broadband Dipole Antenna under Wind Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The complex weather environment has a significant effect on the structural deformation and electrical performance of the broadband dipole antenna. In this paper, an electromechanical coupling analysis method is proposed to analyze the nonlinear response of the Broadband dipole antenna under multi-wind wind load, and the structural analysis of the broadband dipole antenna under wind load is carried out by the nonlinear finite element method, and the electrical performance analysis of the antenna is carried out by the method of moments based on the geometric model of the deformed broadband dipole antenna. The impedance characteristics and pattern of the antenna are calculated under wind load. The calculation results show that the import impedance of the antenna is almost the same, whether the antenna with multi-wind wind load or not. When the antenna is loaded with wind, the antenna pattern has little effect on the low-frequency band and a larger impact on the high-frequency band. The results of this paper provide a basis for the selection and design of the antenna, and the analysis method in this paper has certain reference significance for the same type of antenna.

articleTitle: A Flat Wideband Transmitarray Antenna in D-Band
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel phase-compensation element is proposed in this paper. It includes three metal layers and two patch layers, and hence can be applied to a terahertz transmission array. The structure of the metal layer shows hexagons shape. By adjusting the middle length of the hexagon, the desired phase compensation and high transmission coefficient can be obtained. The D-band transmitting array is designed using this element. The focusing performance of the transmit array is verified with a excited standard horn antenna in a simulation.

articleTitle: Design of U-band Bandpass Filter Based on Loaded Dielectric Slot Gap Waveguide Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a U-band bandpass filter based on dielectric loaded slot gap waveguide is designed. A mushroom-type electromagnetic band-gap structure substrate is used to integrate the slot-gap waveguide. And the dispersive mode method and waveguide transmission method are applied to numerically analyze the mushroom-type band-gap structure. And the mushroom-type band-gap structure is analyzed by using two methods of frequency band-gap numerical analysis. The resonator is designed to achieve dielectric loading by retaining the slot gap waveguide over the dielectric substrate. And it makes the height of the air gap in the middle of the resonator substrate reduced. The result is a filter with a smaller size, narrower bandwidth, and high out-of-band rejection. The physical test results show that the center frequency of the filter is 50 GHz, the bandwidth is 500 MHz, and the relative bandwidth is 1%. And the in-band insertion loss of the filter is less than 3 dB and a return loss is less than −15 dB.

articleTitle: Broadband Circuit Analog Absorber Based on Multilayer Graphene-loaded Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband circuit analog absorber using multilayer and multi-resonant graphene-loaded metasurface is proposed. The absorber consists of two graphene-loaded square metallic loops and a metal plate. Two lossy layers are adopted to broaden the absorption band. The absorption band with −10 dB reflection is 1.2–12.6 GHz, with a fractional bandwidth of 165%. Two Layers are supported by foams, making the structure more stable. The thickness of the structure is only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.098 \lambda_{L}$</tex>, where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda_{L}$</tex> is the wavelength at the lowest frequency. The absorber is polarization insensitive due to its symmetrical structure. Moreover, it has good stability under oblique incident angles.

articleTitle: Research and Verification on Physical Layer Key Parameters for LEO Non-Terrestrial Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper describes physical-layer parameters design for LEO satellite communication based on 5G NR, especially the physical resources, modulation mapper and SS/PBCH block research. At the same time, the rationality of the relevant design is verified through an efficient and economical on-orbit test.

articleTitle: Design of Q-band Filter Based on Folded Step-Impedance Resonator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a miniaturized Q-band bandpass filter with high out-of-band rejection based on a stepped impedance resonator is designed. This filter championed a stepped-impedance resonator structure and is loaded with a stepped-impedance branch on the basic SIR, and the transmission zeros have been introduced through a special folded coupling feed line. Compared with the conventional SIR structure, it has more tuning parameters and a wider tuning range for resonant frequencies. A pair of transmission zeros are introduced simultaneously, which can enhance the rejection characteristics of the stop-band. The passband range of the filter is 43-46GHz, the in-band insertion loss is less than 3dB, the in-band return loss is larger than 15dB, and the out-of-band rejection is larger than 20dB in the frequency range of 35-43GHz and 46-55GHz.

articleTitle: A Ka-Band OAM Reflectarray Antenna Using Hexagonal Phoenix Elements
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel hexagonal phoenix antenna element for Ka-band applications is proposed. By employing this element, a 0-360° phase-shift range in a single layer can be achieved. A 15×15 orbital angular momentum (OAM) reflectarray with mode +2 is designed through this phoenix element in the Ka-band. The simulation results show that the reflectarray has a 1-dB gain bandwidth of 19.2% and a divergence angle of 9°, which can achieve good OAM beam radiation.

articleTitle: An improved NSGA-III Based Unmanned Airborne Conformal Array Beam Pattern Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have been widely used in various fields recently, and for the selection of the array they carry, the conformal array which is integrated with the body is very suitable. Conformal antenna attached to the surface of the object will not interfere with the carrier's dynamic flow field, while the aperture can cover a large angle and is highly concealed. These features have made the conformal antennas attract a lot of attention in applications such as aircraft and high-speed trains. However, the beam formation of conformal arrays requires solving a complex nonlinear multi-objective optimization problem (MOP). The subproblems involved in such MOPs are often contradictory, and how to obtain the optimal as possible for each subproblem under various constraints is the ultimate goal of this type of problem. In this paper, we propose a geo-metrically structured conformal array beam synthesis algorithm based on the improved NSGA-III algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed INSGA-III algorithm has better performance relative to other multi-objective algorithms and other adaptive beamforming algorithms in the solution of this problem.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromagnetic Wave Propagation Characteristics Based on Plasma Turbulence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: On the basis of the standard <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k - 8$</tex> turbulence model, a propagation model of electromagnetic wave in plasma turbulence is established. The expression of dielectric coefficient of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k - 8$</tex> plasma turbulence model is derived from Saha equation of gas ionization and refractive index of plasma. The reflection and transmission coefficients of electromagnetic wave under different turbulent parameters and gas temperature are calculated by using a transmission matrix method, and the propagation characteristics of electromagnetic wave in plasma turbulence are analyzed. Results show that when the number of plasma turbulence increases or the turbulence size increases, the reflection coefficient and transmission coefficient of electromagnetic wave increase in a low frequency range. Conversely, the increase of the outer scale of turbulence will lead to the increase of the reflection coefficient and the decrease of the transmission coefficient. These results provide theoretical basis for studying electromagnetic wave propagation in plasma turbulence.

articleTitle: A Millimeter-Wave Circularly Polarized Curl Antenna and Array
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband circularly polarized curl antenna and its triangular array are proposed for millimeter-wave applications. Circularly polarized radiation is achieved by coaxial cable fed radiating curl. A parasitic stub is introduced to adjust the impedance matching and axial ratio bandwidth. Simulated impedance and axial ratio bandwidths of the element are 32.4% and 13.9%, respectively. A 2 × 2 sequential rotation triangular array shows good performances of wide impedance and AR bandwidth of 34.5% with total efficiency higher than 80%.

articleTitle: A Multiple Wideband Microstrip Antenna Combiner for Indoor Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This letter presents a multiple broadband microstrip antenna combiner for 2G/3G/LTE/Sub-6GHz 5GHz communications. The combiner mainly consists of three parts: a low pass filter, a high pass filter and a three-port network that combines the low pass filter and the high pass filter together. Through flexibly designing the T-junction with stepped impedance and the lines, good filtering characteristic can be achieved. Simulated results show that a frequency bandwidth of 0.16 GHz (0.8-0.96 GHz) can be achieved by port 2, whereas the dual bandwidths of 1.7-2.7 GHz and 3.3-3.6 GHz can be obtained by port 3. Insertions loss are larger than - 4 dB across the working frequency bands. Therefore, the proposed combiner could be suitable for wireless wideband communications.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Data Model of Radar Interference Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In addition to the two main technical evaluation indexes, the application of the radar interference equipment is mainly considered. It can be used effectively to improve the effectiveness of radar interference equipment. This paper focuses on the data modeling of the effectiveness evaluation of radar interference equipment, and has a reference significance for the effectiveness of radar interference equipment.

articleTitle: A Radiation Pattern Reconfigurable Low-Profile Fabry-Perot Antenna Based on Liquid Metal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A Fabry-perot (FP) antenna with radiation pattern reconfigurable by injecting liquid metal into the partially reflective surface (PRS) is presented in this paper. The PRS is divided into three layers, which are symmetrical about X axis and Y axis, and the liquid metal can be injected into the intermediate layer to achieve beam steerable functions. The proposed antenna has a simple structure and the cavity height is only about a quarter of the working wavelength. Simulation results show that the antenna's radiation pattern can achieve up to 15° beam tilting at 9.7 GHz. The proposed FP antenna has excellent reconfigurable performance and low profile, and it can be used in wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Design of a Novel Dual-band Printed Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel dual-band printed dipole antenna operating at 433 MHz and 2390 MHz is proposed and investigated. The antenna is composed of a two-element double-sided printed dipole array which works at high frequency and one arm of the low-frequency dipole. By loading a capacitor, high-frequency arms printed on one side are shared as the low-frequency dipole's another arm. Additionally, the length of the dipole for the lower band is further shortened by loading inductors. The proposed antenna offers a compact antenna configuration, details of the configuration and experimental results are discussed.

articleTitle: 5G Opportunity Signal based Pseudorange Measuring Method and Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) delivery is becoming a new trend with the development of the logistics with drones since its advantage of high-efficiency and zero-contact. High precision positioning is the precondition of the UAV delivery. A novel positioning scheme based on the fifth-generation (5G) new radio (NR) opportunity signal is proposed in this paper to improve the positioning performance in the global satellite navigation system (GNSS)-denied environment. The solution process of 5G opportunities signals is introduced in this paper in detail. Firstly, the standard 5G downlink waveform is generated by 5G toolbox. Secondly, the waveform is passed through the tap delay line (TDL) channel model which is specified in 3GPP TR 38.901. Finally, the local receiver is designed to calculate the pseudorange information by utilizing the primary synchronization signal (PSS) and second synchronization signal (SSS) in the SSB burst. The simulation results show that the ranging error of a single base station with accurate initial location is 10.942m and the ranging positioning error of multi base stations with unknown initial location is 13.581m.

articleTitle: 3D Micro-Motion Parameter Extraction of Spinning Targets Based on Rotating Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The micro-Doppler effect is regarded as a unique feature of the target with micro-motion, which can provide important information for the classification and recognition of the target. In this paper, a three-dimensional (3D) micro-motion features extraction method of spinning target based on rotating antenna is proposed. In this new radar configuration, the micro-Doppler curve of spinning target is the addition of two sinusoidal signals, and the orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm can be used to reconstruct the 3D micro-motion features of spinning target. The application cost of this method is low, and the requirements for radar system are not high. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking Based On Mutual Information-Temporal Weight Aggregation Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of multi-target multi-camera tracking, the method of detection and tracking is used to complete single-camera multi-target tracking, and a person re-identification model using mutual information time weight aggregation is proposed to extract appearance features, and determine whether the camera is in the camera. A new method for cross-camera multi-target tracking is finally performed. We use the deep learning framework Pytorch to build network models and tune model-related parameters and compare experiments with existing models on the dataset. The results show that the model has better tracking performance.

articleTitle: Application of Analytic Hierarchy Process in Ship Electromagnetic Compatibility Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Modern ships are equipped with a large number of electronic information system equipment. With the continuous development of information technology and equipment, the electromagnetic compatibility of ships has gradually become an important factor restricting their operational effectiveness. Studying and establishing the evaluation index system of ship electromagnetic compatibility and carrying out the quantitative evaluation of ship electromagnetic compatibility are of great significance to improve ship electromagnetic compatibility and give full play to its combat performance. Based on the evaluation indexes of electromagnetic compatibility of ships at home and abroad, combined with the loading characteristics of modern ships, this paper studies and establishes the evaluation index system of electromagnetic compatibility of ships, which includes 6 categories and 23 indexes. The improved analytic hierarchy process is used to calculate and verify the electromagnetic compatibility of ships, and the performance of electromagnetic compatibility of ships is quantitatively evaluated, so as to provide technical support for accurately mastering the state of electromagnetic compatibility of ships.

articleTitle: Simulation of Radiation Energy of Lithium Niobate Crystal Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, the popularity of portable or autonomous vehicle platform has increased the demand for miniaturized antennas. Based on the modeling of Lithium Niobate piezoelectric effect, this paper simulates and analyzes the external power release of Lithium Niobate crystal antenna. Using the piezoelectric module in the multiple physical field simulation software COMSOL, the geometric model of lithium niobate crystal antenna is constructed and the frequency domain calculation is carried out to analyze the relationship between the external electric energy released by the lithium niobate antenna and the input. The simulation results show that in the range of 30-40kHz, when the input voltage changes, the external radiation energy has a square relationship with the input and the calculation shows that the external radiation efficiency of lithium niobate crystal antenna is extremely low.

articleTitle: Design of a Butterfly Shaped Reflective Multifunctional Polarization Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a butterfly shaped ultra-thin reflective multifunctional polarization converter. It is capable of cross-polarization conversion and linear circular polarization conversion in multiple frequency ranges. High-efficiency cross-polarization conversion occurs in (6.40-8.45 GHz) and (18.3-24.94 GHz) in these frequency ranges. In these two frequency bands, we can see that the polarization conversion rate exceeds 90%. Linear circular polarization conversion is realized at (9.19-16.4 GHz), at the same time the axial ratio (AR) value is always kept less than 3dB in this frequency range, and the relative bandwidth reached 56.35%. The design also maintains stable performance at incident angles less than 30°.

articleTitle: A two -step optimization method for ship navigation decision-making with emission control area
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Several Emission Control Areas (ECAs) have been delineated recently by the International Maritime Organization to reduce the ship emissions in the relevant areas, where ships are forced to use more expensive low-sulphur fuel. To minimum the total costs for any navigate, optimizing the route and speed with the constraint of ECAs is vital for shipping companies. In this paper, the problem for simultaneous optimizing the ship route and speed was described firstly, and then a two-step strategy for modeling the problem was proposed. After the navigation area was discretized into equal-sized cells, a directed graph was established, and the total costs function was proposed for each feasible route which is a combination of edges. Then, the models for optimizing route and speed were advanced with the target to minimize the total costs. As traditional route optimization algorithms will fall into local optimum with the influence of ECAs, an improved Ant Colony Algorithm was presented by promoting a dispersion function to expand the solution space. Finally, two case studies were applied, and the comparative analysis results show that the proposed method can reduce the ship sailing cost by nearly 10% or more.

articleTitle: Detection of Advanced Pulse Compression Noise Based on FRFT
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Advanced Pulse Compression noise is a kind of signal with the advantages of linear frequency modulation signal and noise signal. In this paper, time-frequency analysis method based on fractional Fourier transform is used for the detection of APCN signal. Also, we derive the detection principle of this method in detail. The proposed method using time-frequency conversion provides better detection performance than previous methods for the detection of APCN signal. In addition, choosing appropriate signal parameters can make APCN signal obtain a large time-bandwidth product and provide low detection performance. Simulation results are presented to verify the theoretical prediction.

articleTitle: ISAR Range Alignment Under Sparse Aperture Condition Based on CRAN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Range alignment (RA) is the first step of inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) translational compensation. However, the precision of traditional range alignment method for non-cooperative targets will dramatically decreases under sparse aperture condition. We propose a CRAN-RA (CNN RNN Attention mechanism Network-Range Alignment) method to address the problem by combining convolutional neural networks (CNN) and recurrent neural networks (RNN) with attention mechanism. The unified network can effectively integrate regional features extracted by CNN and temporal features extracted by RNN. Input unaligned echoes, the network can predict the aligned echoes. Compared with the traditional methods and RNN-based methods, the experiments show that the proposed network can significantly improve the alignment accuracy under sparse aperture and low SNR condition.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Multi-electrode Structure of Large-scale Capacitive Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this brief, six large-size multi-electrode planar capacitive sensor (PCS) structures are designed for small target detection. Firstly, the six different sensors were simulated using the boundary element method in COMSOL Multiphysics. Secondly, we compared the performance of the six sensors in terms of sensitive field distribution, sensitivity and initial capacitance, and the results show that the triangular comb-shaped sensor performs the best. Lastly, the effect of the ratio of the electrode spacing to the electrode width of the triangular comb-shaped electrode on the sensitivity distribution of the sensor is discussed. The simulation results demonstrate that the larger the ratio is, the better the consistency of the sensor sensitivity distribution.

articleTitle: Improvement of performance of Actuator with Adjustable Stiffness (AwAS) using Adaptive control methodology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, robots have assisted physiotherapists in some parts of their rehabilitation exercises. Because patient health is so essential, rehabilitation robots must be highly safe. The use of variable stiffness actuators is one of the most widely used methods in construction rehabilitation robots. This article improves the mechanism of an actuator called AWaS. AWaS uses one motor to control the displacement and another motor to control the stiffness of the mechanism. In this paper, the torque and energy required to change the mechanism's stiffness are reduced by changing the mechanism. Also, the adaptive control method is used to prevent vibrations and minimize the position error and stiffness of the mechanism. This mechanism has three inputs and three outputs coupled to each other. This paper uses a method to control nonlinear coupled MIMO systems.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Multifunctional RF Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: At present, heterogeneous multifunctional integrated circuits are widely used in weapons and equipment, aerospace, new generation mobile communications, new energy vehicles, and other fields. In this process, the independent innovation and development of multi-functional RF integrated circuits suitable for various occasions is the core technology to improve China's combat effectiveness. GaAs and Si, which are widely used at present, as well as the third-generation semiconductor SiC and Gan, are of great significance to create multi-functional communication methods and strategies through radio frequency integrated circuits and heterogeneous integration, so as to enhance the core advantages of weapons and equipment.

articleTitle: Simulation of Parameters of A Microstrip Array Antenna Based on Equivalent Source
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces a simulation calculation method of electromagnetic parameters of microstrip antenna array based on equivalent source. The calculation method first determines the active element pattern of the smallest array element, and deduces the pattern of the array composed of super-large and complex array elements that needs to be calculated by means of an equivalent source. The electromagnetic parameter simulation calculation method can greatly reduce the electromagnetic parameter simulation calculation amount of a large-scale antenna array, reduce calculation time, reduce hardware resource requirements, and improve scientific research efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Channel Equalization Algorithm in SC-FDE System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In single-carrier aeronautical communication systems, the time-varying multipath propagation characteristics of the channel give rise to severe inter-code interference. Radio channel distortion compensation and inter-code interference cancellation are generally achieved by equalization techniques. In this paper, zero-forcing equalization, minimum mean square error equalization and minimum mean square error adaptive equalization algorithms for SC-FDE systems are investigated, but the traditional LMS algorithms cannot meet the performance requirements of convergence speed and steady-state error at the same time because the step size factor is fixed. This paper investigates the variable step size LMS algorithm and proposes an improved variable step size LMS algorithm, which uses the non-linear relationship between the error factor and the error function to construct a correlation correction function, to regulate the error factor in a small range, and to further correct the step size factor through the change of the error factor. The LMS algorithm is divided into a training mode and a tracking mode, and the two modes are combined to achieve a faster convergence rate. The computer simulation results are consistent with the theoretical analysis and confirm that the algorithm outperforms the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Robust State of Charge Estimation via KMPE Loss based Extreme Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Since energy storage system (ESS) usually works under complex environments that are susceptible to noise or other random fluctuations, it is crucial to develop robust state of charge (SOC) estimation methods in battery management system for effectively management of the ESS. The mean square error (MSE) criterion based original extreme learning machine (ELM) model can only perform well under Gaussian measurement noise. To enhance the estimation accuracy of ELM under non-Gaussian measurement noise, a new robust ELM is utilized to achieve accurate estimation of SOC in this paper, in which the kernel mean p-power error (KMPE) loss with wider performance surface and flexibility is used to replace the MSE in conventional ELM. Some experiments are conducted to test the effectiveness of the proposed approach for SOC estimation under various work conditions with complex non-Gaussian measurement noises.

articleTitle: An UWB Omnidirectional Monopole for Broadband Electromagnetic Environment Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An ultra-wideband omnidirectional torch-shaped monopole antenna is proposed in this letter for electromagnetic environment monitoring. The proposed antenna is formed by a coaxial cable feed, circular floor, and torch-like radiator. With antenna shaping, the achieved antenna keeps good omnidirectional radiation performance in the ultra-wide operating frequency band. At the same time, it can meet the impedance matching over working frequency band in a compact size. All these characteristics make the proposed monopole antenna a good candidate for electromagnetic environment monitoring.

articleTitle: Comparison of Non-Diffraction Microstrip Antennas and Traditional Microstrip Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A microstrip antenna array with a centre frequency of 5.8 GHz is proposed in this study, which can generate a non-diffractive Bessel beam to achieve no change in radiation intensity at the maximum diffractive distance. We compare the traditional microstrip antenna with the non-diffractive antenna simulation in multiple directions, and the numerical simulation results show that compared with the traditional microstrip antenna array, the array has the advantages of radiating main lobe width, energy in the maximum non-diffractive distance (1.19m) to maintain radiation intensity without attenuation, etc., more suitable for use in the near field, and has an application scenario worth looking forward to in the future 6G wireless communication.

articleTitle: A High Shielding Effectiveness Waveguide Window Designed for Modern Combat Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: There are more electronic and electrical devices in modern combat vehicles than ever. Such vehicles are required to have complete protection when faced with electromagnetic pulses on the battlefield, which is aim to reduce the impact of external electromagnetic interference on the electrical equipment inside the vehicles. However, under operating conditions, the temperature of integrated supply systems and high-voltage electric drive systems will increase significantly. In order to ensure that the system function is not affected, good ventilation and heat dissipation performance is required. In this paper, a novel electromagnetic shielding structure for the vehicle window is proposed, the structure is cascaded by connecting a rectangular waveguide filter to a waveguide array, which can achieve a high-efficiency electromagnetic shielding performance of 40dB in the range of 100MHz-2GHz, and have a good heat dissipation performance in the meanwhile.

articleTitle: Multitask Diffusion Least-Mean-Fourth Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In some applications, the multitask network may be corrupted by non-Gaussian noise, e.g., uniform noise or binary noise. If the multitask diffusion LMS algorithm is used in such situations, its steady-state performance will be degraded. To overcome this issue, this work presents a multitask diffusion version of the least-mean-fourth algorithm by using the fourth-order moment of the estimation error. To further enhance its convergence rate, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l_{0}$</tex>-norm regularization is used. Simulation results show that our algorithms can obtain small steady-state mean-square deviation (MSD).

articleTitle: Polarization Effects of Holographic Penetrating Imaging Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As the essential property of electromagnetic waves, polarization is an important basic parameter other than frequency amplitude, and phase, and describes the vector characteristics of electromagnetic waves. In this paper, the influence of radar polarization mode on target imaging ability is studied, and polarization modes such as horizontal copolarization, vertical co-polarization, and cross-polarization are designed, which is validated by the combination of a cross-shaped target and a X-shaped target attitudes experiment. Through experiments, some rules of radar polarization mode pair and target detection ability are summarized, which have guiding significance for the design and use of holographic penetrating imaging radar system.

articleTitle: Bandpass Hairpin Filters Harmonics Suppression by Using the Combination of Open Circuit Stub and Spur-line
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a microstrip bandpass filter which uses a variety of structures to suppress harmonics. By connecting two open-circuit stub lines in parallel in the resonator and introducing spur line into the coupling section, it can further suppress harmonics while ensuring good performance of passband. The center frequency of the hairpin filter designed in this paper is 2.5GHz and bandwidth is 200 MHz, which covers the blue-tooth communication band. And extend stopband with a rejection level of 37.5 dB up to 2f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>, the harmonic suppression effect of the combination of the two structures is much better than that of the single one which can further ensure the performance of the passband.

articleTitle: Free Space Transmission Technique for Microwave Detection of Wheat Moisture Content
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Moisture content is an essential indicator for assessing wheat quality, which determines the safety of wheat storage. A measurement system based on the principle of microwave transmission method is designed for a fast and non-destructive grain moisture content determination. The detection system mainly consists of the Agilent PNA-X Series Microwave Network Analyzer, the transmitting and receiving horn antennas, the slide rail, and the sample groove. The key idea of this research is to verify the linear relationship between the scattering parameter and the moisture content in a specific frequency range of 2.6-4.0 GHz. The correlation coefficient and root mean square error are used to evaluate the fitting degree of the linear model. The experimental results might provide a new reference for online real-time detection of wheat quality.

articleTitle: Generalized Correntropy Induced Metric Based Block Sparse Memory Improved Proportionate Affine Projection Sign Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, by combining the block sparse memory improved proportionate affine projection sign algorithm (BS-MIP- APSA) and the generalized correntropy induced metric (GCIM), we have proposed two block sparse adaptive filtering algorithms, named as GCIM-BS-MIP-APSA-I and GCIM-BS-MIP-APSA-II, by directly using GCIM to measure the sparse information and treating GCIM as a function of block weight vector, respectively, for identification of sparse systems. Based on the good characteristic of GCIM approximating the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\ell_{0}$</tex>-norm, the proposed algorithms, especially GCIM-BS-MIP-APSA-II, can achieve improved filtering accuracy and faster convergence rate when the identified system is block sparse. We also have analyzed the computational complexity of proposed algorithms. Some simulation results are conducted to demonstrate the efficiency of GCIM-BS-MIP-APSAs compared with other competing algorithms.

articleTitle: Detection Mechanism of Money Laundering based on Random Walk and Skip-Grim Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Money laundering means that criminals use the services provided by banks to transfer a large amount of illegal funds to untraceable destination accounts. Most of the related works are rule-based and machine learning based anti-money laundering systems. However, the anti-money laundering systems based on machine learning are affected by the data scale of money laundering transactions. The rule-based anti-money laundering systems require a lot of manual work and cannot adapt to the changing money laundering behavior. Therefore, this paper designs a money laundering detection mechanism based on random walk and skip-grim model. This detection mechanism preferentially constructs an account transfer graph. Then, on this basis, it generates random transfer trajectories for each account using the random walk algorithm. Thereafter, the transfer characteristics of each user are automatically analyzed from the random transfer trajectories utilizing the skip-grim model. Finally, it compares the extracted transfer characteristics of different users and combines the cosine similarity to identify illegal money laundering users. Last, we use python programming language and cbank dataset to evaluate the performance of the proposed scheme, and we compare our work with the related works, flowscope and Martin jullum. The extensive simulation results validate that, the proposed scheme has better identification effect, correctly identifying more than 80% of the money laundering accounts, and the misjudgment rate is less than 20 %.

articleTitle: Deformation Monitoring Method Based on Adaptive Segmentation and Correlation Matching
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Deformation measurement is an important method in the monitoring of structural engineering safety. Most of the traditional measuring methods require humans to conduct surveys and field tests, which is complicated to operate, and the uncertainty of measurement accuracy is difficult to overcome. To tackle with this problem, this paper designs an automatic monitoring system for deformation and displacement based on adaptive segmentation and correlation matching method. By fixed-point monitoring technology, real-time images of bridges/buildings are obtained, and the coordinates of targets are dynamically obtained and converted into deformation data to achieve high-precision non-contact real-time measurement, based on computer vision and target positioning techniques. According to our experiments, the deformation and displacement monitoring system achieves the purpose of all-weather monitoring of structure health.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Hermite Nonlinear Filter for Active Noise Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this article, a class of low-complexity Hermite nonlinear (HN) filters is proposed for nonlinear active noise control (NLANC). The HN filters belong to linear-in-the-parameter (LIP) nonlinear filters, which also have the orthogonal property for white input signals. Based on the HN filters, the fast affine projection algorithm (FAPA) and the dichotomous coordinate descent (DCD) method are introduced, generating DCD-filtered-h FAPA (DCD-FhFAPA). Benefiting from fast recursive filtering and DCD strategies, the computational complexity of the algorithm can be reduced. To further alleviate computational complexity, two methods of discarding redundant data are proposed based on the Mahalanobis distance, leading to the DCD-low-complexity filtered-h FAPA-I (DCD-LFhFAPA-I) and DCD-LFhFAPA-II algorithms. At the price of slightly slow convergence, two new algorithms significantly reduce the computational load for NLANC. Simulation results exhibit the effectiveness of the DCD-FhFAPA, DCD-LFhFAPA-I, and DCD-LFhFAPA-II algorithms.

articleTitle: Off-Grid Sparse Spectrum Fitting for DOA Estimation with Unknown Mutual Coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm based on sparse spectrum fitting is proposed to solve the problem of DOA off-grid estimation under the condition of unknown mutual coupling. In the proposed method, the influence of mutual coupling is firstly eliminated by constructing a selection matrix by exploiting the banded complex symmetric Toeplitz structure of the mutual coupling matrix. Then, in the process of sparse recovery based on signal covariance, additional variables are employed to describe the modeling error caused by off-grid DOA. Finally, the constraints of sparse recovery are optimized by the improved covariance estimation error and chi-square distribution. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by comparing the performance of the proposed algorithm with several existing DOA estimation methods and Cramer-Rao bound (CRB) through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: FRDVDnet: Towards Fast and Robust Deep Video Denoising
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the rapid development of the technology of deep learning, lots of deep video denoising networks emerged. The mainstream deep video denoising(DVD) algorithms with the property of excellent detail preservation and the ability to process a wide range of noise level, such as FastDVDnet, are only based on the fixed datasets without enough generalizability. In order to deal with this problem, a network for fast and robust DVD called FRDVDnet, is proposed in this paper for optimizing FastDVDnet by utilizing dense-scale feature fusion mechanism and CReLU activation scheme. We compare FRDVDnet with FastDVDnet tested in the mid-scale bayer benchmark dataset visually and quantitatively. The simulation result shows that the denoising performance of FRDVDnet is improved with the increasing of the noise intensity compared to FastDVDnet. Moreover, in terms of perservation of key detail, FRDVDnet is superior to FastDVDnet on the denoised video.

articleTitle: Millimeter wave Broadband Co-frequency Duplex Yagi Antenna Based on Self-packaged Multi-layer SISL
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband co-frequency duplex Yagi antenna for 5G millimeter wave band is proposed based on the LTCC multi-layer SISL. The antenna structure is self-packaged and has excellent performance. The center frequency of the co-frequency duplex Yagi antenna is designed at 33.25GHz, and the 10dB impedance relative bandwidth is 25.6%. The transceiver port isolation of the antenna is 12.7dB, and the maximum gain is 6.3dB. The cross-polarization levels of the main radiation directions of the E and H planes of the antenna are below −15dB.

articleTitle: Analysis of Field Coupling on Cables for Pulse Current Injection Test
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Electromagnetic pulse (EMP) protection has attracted more and more attention in the field of ships and some EMP equipments have been developed. Pulse current injection (PCI) test can well verify the EMP effect of equipment by injecting high current into the equipment cable and monitoring the residual current. We conducted PCI tests for two types of UPS equipments and found that the crosstalk between the cables was severe. Therefore, we conducted electromagnetic simulations for these two types of equipments to find the optimal layout of the cables to reduce the impact of crosstalk.

articleTitle: Investigation of Cross-Polarization on GNSS-R Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper investigates the requirements of the GNSS-Scatterometer. Remote sensing algorithms have been applied for extracting geophysical characteristics of the ground where the reflection of the GPS signal occurs. In particular, different characteristics of cross-polarization (X-pol) of antennas designed for GNSS-R experiments are tested and shown. This study is useful for GNSS-related experiments for improving the accuracy of parameter retrievals.

articleTitle: Orthogonal-Mode Decoupling Antenna Pair Based on Asymmetric Non-Differential Feed Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents an orthogonal-mode decoupling antenna pair based on asymmetric non-differential feed mode. The main structure of the proposed antenna pair comprises a monopole antenna and a dipole antenna, placed above the ground plane. Antenna pairs realize decoupling property by the modal orthogonality of these two independent antenna elements without additional decoupling components, even though these two antenna elements share the same space in the same location.
