In our approach, the dipole antenna is fed by a coupling branch at one side of the dipole arm, avoiding the differential feed scheme at both sides that requires a balun chip. In order to ensure good isolation between the dipole and monopole antennas operating in the same frequency band, an asymmetric dipole is designed. The antenna pair shows an impendence bandwidth of 3.05-3.9 GHz by employing the orthogonal-mode design scheme, the maximum isolation across the target frequency band can reach more than 21 dB. The simulation results show that the envelope correlation coefficient between two antenna ports is lower than 0.03. The total efficiencies of the monopole and dipole antennas are 58%-90% and 59%-89% across 3.05-3.9 GHz, respectively. The proposed design scheme has the advantages of simple feed, high integration, and simple implementation, so it has potentials for 5G MIMO applications.

articleTitle: Sparse Bayesian Learning with Generalized Double Pareto Prior for Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Vibration analysis has been widely used in bearing fault diagnosis. However, accurate fault impulse extraction from vibration signals with strong background noise is still a challenging task for bearing fault diagnosis. Although the sparse representation (SR) methods can achieve state-of-the-art performance, most of these methods rely on manually tuning several hyper-parameters, and performance may be degraded due to approximate regularization and/or heuristic sparse models. To overcome these shortcomings and extract the fault impulse more accurately, in the paper, we present a sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) framework for bearing fault diagnosis, where we exploit the group-sparsity structure and introduce additional Generalized Double Pareto (GDP) prior to enforce the sparsity of the fault impulse heavily. Through several groups of experiments, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method are proved.

articleTitle: A Dual-polarized Patch Antenna Array with The Decoupling Structure with Polarization Rotation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a 1 × 2 dual-polarized patch antenna array with the decoupling structure with polarization rotation (DSPR) has been proposed. A dual-polarized patch antenna is realized by two double torsion coil feeding (DTC) structures. And the band of the antenna is from 3.24 GHz to 3.86 GHz with a high isolation better than 25 dB. The DSPRs are placed above the antenna array to reduce the mutual coupling. Finally, the coupling between co-polarization is decreased from −19 dB to −26 dB and the coupling between cross-polarization is reduced from −22 dB to −25 dB. As a consequence, the antenna array has a wide frequency band spanning from 3.44 GHz to 3.83 GHz with high isolation.

articleTitle: A Novel Wilkinson Power Divider with High Harmonic Suppression Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this letter, a novel Wilkinson power divider consisting of Π type structures with harmonic suppression performance is proposed. Because open-ended stubs in Π type structures will produce transmission zeros of S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>, the harmonic suppression of power divider is realized by adjusting the different electrical lengths of open-ended stubs to produce multi-transmission zeros. The mathematical relations of substitution about transmission lines and Π type structures are deducted, and several design examples are discussed. Finally, an experimental circuit is fabricated and measured, and a high consistency exists between them.

articleTitle: Compiled Code Study of Joint Parity and Cyclic Redundancy Check
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Error correction coding, channel coding, also known as error control coding, is to add some redundant code elements, or check code elements, to form a correlated sequence of code elements—code words and to use the correlation property between code elements to detect and correct errors when decoding. Different error correction coding schemes have different error detection and correction capabilities. This paper designs a combination of parity check and cyclic redundancy check (CRC) to improve the error detection and correction capabilities with minimum cost, so that the system can transmit information more efficiently while also having high transmission reliability.

articleTitle: A Compact Tri-band Single Circularly Polarized Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A tri-band antenna is designed by using the coplanar waveguide feeding method. In order to reduce the size of the antenna, a hollow rectangular stepped structure is constructed. The three operating frequencies are 2.9 GHz, 3.3 GHz and 4.1 GHz respectively, which meet the requirements of 5G (5th Generation) communication and radio navigation frequency bands respectively. And the circular polarization is realized at the resonance frequency of 4.1 GHz. The size of the antenna is only 40×40 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and it has the advantages of simple structure, wide coverage frequency band, and good radiation performance.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Multi-Beam Antenna System Based on Strongly Coupled Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this article, a miniaturized design of multi beam antenna system based on strongly coupled antenna is proposed. By opening the connection part of the cross junction of the multi-beam feed network, all couplers are closed-loop connected in turn. The space in the open cross junction ring is used to set the antenna array, and the purpose of miniaturization is achieved. Subsequently, the problem of coupling between antennas is faced. In this paper, the decoupling structure using the concept of phase shift of antenna array is used. According to this structure, the simulation of four antennas is carried out and on this basis. In the last part, the multi beam antenna system is simulated and analyzed after adding Butler matrix. The system has good performance and good miniaturization effect.

articleTitle: A K/Ka-Band Diplex Circularly Polarized Horn Antenna with High Isolation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a K/Ka-band diplex circularly polarized horn antenna with high isolation is proposed for satellite communication systems. The proposed antenna is composed of a metal waveguide diplexer and a septum circular polarizer. The metal waveguide diplexer will provide dual channels with high isolation characteristics, while the septum circular polarizer is capable of transmitting and receiving two orthogonal circularly polarized signals simultaneously. The simulated results show that the proposed antenna achieves a reflection coefficient of less than −10 dB, an isolation of less than −68 dB, and an axial ratio lower than 3dBat the frequency band of 18.5-21.5 GHz and 27-32 GHz, respectively. The good performances make the proposed antenna a good candidate for the satellite communication system.

articleTitle: Global Projective Synchronization of Fractional-Order Quatemion-Valued Memristor-Based Neural Networks with Delays
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, based on a non-separate approach, the global projective synchronization problem of multi-delay fractional-order quaternary memristive networks is investigated. Firstly, the paper cites fractional inequalities, and the problem of global projective synchronization of the system is studied using the method of quaternary non-separation. Secondly, under the framework of set-valued mapping and differential inclusion theory, an open-loop controller is designed, and a 1-norm Lyapunov function is constructed to study the global projection synchronization problem of the system. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the quaternion global projection synchronization strategy are verified by a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Study on the Radiation Enhencement of Electrical Small Antenna in Plasma Sheath
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a new method based on the resonance matching of electrical small monopole antenna and subwavelength plasma sheath for suppressing communication interruption of hypersonic vehicle is proposed, which can achieve normal communication in the plasma sheath without changing the operating electromagnetic frequency (L and S band). The simulation model is established with CST software. The effect of electron density, collision frequency and thickness of plasma sheath is studied in detail.

articleTitle: A Focusing Transmitarray Antenna Using Trilayer Metasurface Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a new type of transmitarray with three-layer ring Wanzi transmission element is designed and tested. Using the dipole element, by changing the arm length and other dimensions of the unit, the unit can achieve 330 ° transmission phase variation range under the condition of attenuation below −2dB. When the transmission amplitude is better than −2.5dB, the unit can achieve 360 ° transmission phase variation range. Compared with the single-layer structure, the transmission phase range is significantly improved. The element is used to design the transmission array antenna. The simulation results show that the antenna can focus the electromagnetic wave and adjust the focus position.

articleTitle: A Dual-Frequency WIFI Phased Array Antennas System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-frequency WIFI phased array antennas system is presented. The system consists of 2.4-2.5GHz Phased Array Antennas, 5.15-5.85GHz Phased Array Antennas, 2.4-2.5GHz transmitter and receiver (TR) components, 5.15-5.85GHz transmitter and receiver (TR) components, and control board. There are toggle switches that can control the configuration of the phased array antennas. The system can form ± 45º beam steering by changing the phase of the antenna array. Moreover, the antennas are circularly polarized which can improve the transmitting and receiving efficiency for linearly polarized WIFI signals. To validate the effectiveness of the system, the proposed antennas, TR components, and control board are designed, fabricated, and measured. In two frequency bands, the system can realize ± 45º beam steering. This phased array antennas system is a potential alternative in some WIFI communication systems.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-wide band Filter Based on Stub-Loaded Fan-stepped Impedance Resonator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper adopts the form of the multimode resonator, and proposes a three-mode resonator that uses a new type of stub-loaded quarter-wavelength fan-stepped impedance resonator. This resonator has a symmetric structure, and its resonance characteristics can be analyzed by the odd-even mode analysis method, which can simplify the design process. And the characteristics of the fan-loaded two-finger coupling structure are analyzed, which can effectively improve the performance of the filter. The center frequency of the filter is 6.85GHz, the passband range is 3.1-10.6GHz, the in-band insertion loss is less than 2dB, the return loss is less than −20dB, and the out-of-band rejection is less than −40dB at 2GHz and 12GHz.

articleTitle: Study of Mobile Robot positioning based on Ultra-Wideband System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to achieve high precision indoor positioning, UWB positioning scheme was proposed. This positioning system was based on the combination of DS-TWR algorithm and TDOA algorithm, which eliminated the problem of time desynchronization between positioning base stations and tag. The collected outlier data was filtered to remove signals disturbed by noise. The Kalman filtering was introduced for predictive estimation of localization data. The experimental results showed that the root-mean-square error in the X-axis direction and Y-axis direction after Kalman filtering was controlled within 10 cm, which improved about 5 cm compared with the actual measurement positioning error.

articleTitle: Integrated Waveform Design via Pilot-Based OFDM for Joint Radar and Communication System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to efficiently realize the integration of radar and communication (IRC), a pilot-based orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) radar and communication integration waveform design method is proposed. This method makes full use of the existing pilot signal in the communication system and combines the pilot with the phase-encoded signal. It can realize the radar detection by making slight changes on the original communication system, which does not sacrifice the communication performance such as communication rate. Meanwhile, in order to further enhance the anti-jamming capability of the radar signal, chaotic sequences are introduced as the phase encoding sequence to the pilot. The simulation results show that the ambiguity function of the designed integrated signal has an excellent pushpin shape and high range and velocity resolution. At the same time, the overall system has a high communication rate and a low communication bit error rate.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Proportional Resource Allocation in Joint CommRadar System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The joint CommRadar system can make good use of spectrum resources, compared with deploying the two systems alone. We introduce the orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) into the joint CommRadar system, through which users can share frequency band resources. This paper studies the problem of maximizing the sum of user data rates through the basic allocation of subcarriers and power, taking into account the limitations of the total system power, radar detection performance and the ratio between user data rates. Simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed algorithm and achieves higher user data rates while significantly reducing the computational complexity.

articleTitle: A Balance between High-Density Development and Ancient Ruins Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A balance between high-density development and ancient ruins protection is discussed in this paper. After classifying the development process of urban renewal and reconstruction of Shenzhen old villages, two typical high-density development cases are studied in terms of relationship between ancient villages and cities. Based on the above-mentioned actual cases, a strategy of balanced growth between the ancient ruins and high density development is proposed.

articleTitle: Multistable State of Six Dimensional Memristor HR Neuron Model and Its Hardware Implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a new six dimensional memristor HR neuron model, the model is an improvement to the existing memristor HR model. It uses a cosine memristor and a sine memristor in neurons, respectively for the coupling and electromagnetic induction coupling. The model has no equilibrium point. Through the phase diagram and the bifurcation diagram, the Lyapunov index spectrum analyses its dynamic behavior, finding an improved memristor HR neuron model can show the boosting behavior, and changing the initial value of memristor can produce firing pattern booster to different discrete levels. The dissipation of the proposed model is studied. These patterns are homogeneous with extreme stability. Finally, the simulation results could be captured through the stm32 implementation and the oscilloscope. The results agree with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Based on 2.5-D Large Angular Oblique Incidence and Polarization Insensitive Absorber Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a via-based novel metamaterial absorber (MA) for achieving stable energy absorption at/under oblique incidence of large angle. The TMV s of the absorber are located in the center of the patches to connect the two metal patches from different sides to achieve the miniaturization effect. This method reduces the center frequency of MA by introducing a vertical TMV s to play an important role in angle stability and polarization insensitivity. A set of closed-form equations were applied to effectively calculate the circuit inductances and capacitances, and the changes caused by the addition of vias can be seen more visually. Meanwhile, according to the vector transmission line equations, the impedance characteristics of transmission line at large angular oblique incidence can be obtained, and the design of the absorber can be simplified by matching the impedance with that of the free space. Finally, a MA with angle stability and polarization insensitivity characteristic is designed. The simulation results show that when the oblique incident angle is in the range of 60 to 70 degrees, the bandwidth is 2GHz (from 11.98GHz to 13.11GHz) with a high absorptivity (≥ 90%) for both TE- and TM- mode.

articleTitle: Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna Based on Multimode Resonance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this design, a method called dual-mode com-pression is applied for dipole antennas. In this method, the varactor diodes are loaded on the dipole antenna. By changing the bias voltage across the varactor diode, the resonant frequency of the third mode remains almost unchanged, while the resonant frequency of the first mode changes accordingly, enabling the antenna's frequency to be reconfigured. For the designed antenna model, the simulation results indicate that the resonant frequency of the first mode can vary in the range of 0.858GHz-1.2GHz, while the resonant frequency of the third mode remains almost unchanged at 2.43GHz. At the resonant frequency of the third mode, the antenna gain ranges from 2.92dBi to 3.17dBi.

articleTitle: A Task Offloading Strategy for Compute-Intensive Scenarios in UAV-Assisted IoV
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the development of the low-altitude digital economy and the further improvement of the Internet of Vehicles (IoV), the IoV assisted by Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) has been promoted in many fields. Under task-intensive scenarios, UAV-assisted Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) has been extensively studied due to its flexibility and efficiency. However, with random distribution of computing data, the deployment of UAV and offloading strategy are important issues to be solved. In this context, this paper proposes a UAV-assisted offloading strategy, considering fixed and mobile edge nodes respectively, to meet the requirements of low latency and high reliability of vehicle users. It has been experimentally verified that our system reduces the delay by 30%.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-Polarized Dipole Antenna Element for 5G Base Stations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-polarized dipole antenna is proposed in the 5G communication frequency band. The feed portion is designed to be T-shaped structure for good <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$50-\Omega$</tex> impedance matching. Each feed port is responsible for one polarization direction. Due to the S-shaped symmetric structure, the antenna radiation patterns in the dual polarized directions are almost the same. Simulated results exhibit the overlapped operating bandwidth is 3.3-3.8 GHz, the peak gain is 9.5 dBi, and the horizontal and vertical beamwidths are about <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$60\pm 5^{\circ}$</tex>.

articleTitle: A Low-profile Dual-polarized Ultra-wideband Metal Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-polarized ultra-wideband phased array composed of low-profile metal antennas is presented. The design allows for practical implementation of the tightly coupled dipole arrays (TCDAs) at VHF-UHF frequencies. Integrated metal dipole and Marchand balun are designed to ensure the antenna structure's robustness. The dipole consists of vertical and planar components, resulting in a low profile and good impedance matching. The antenna array exhibits an operational bandwidth of 4.6:1 for ±45° scanning in all planes, maintaining active VSWR < 3. Orthogonal port isolation remains below -26 dB when scanning in E-/H-planes. The element spacing and profile of the array are 0.535λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf> and 0.44λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf> (λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf> refers to the wavelength at the highest operating frequency in free space), respectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Value Evaluation System of Macao's Industrial Heritage from the Perspective of Protection and Renewal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Industrial heritage value evaluation is of great significance to identifying and protecting industrial heritage. There are two types of industrial heritage value assessment, one is the assessment of industrial heritage; the other is the pre-assessment work done on the reuse of industrial heritage, both of which are used to protect the value of industrial heritage better. The industrial heritage value evaluation system is summarized, and a Macao's industrial heritage value evaluation system from the perspective of protection and renewal is established. The relevance and coordination of value evaluation, protection, and renewal measures are explored, the overall consideration framework of the updated strategy is summarized.

articleTitle: Constant modulus waveform design for radar with Doppler tolerance based on local ambiguity function template matching
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To tackle the problem of Doppler sensitivity of phase-coded waveform in radar systems, a method for designing transmit waveform with Doppler tolerance under constant modulus (CM) constraint is considered. In this method, the variance between the ideal local ambiguity function (LAF) and the real one is used as the objective function to establish an optimization problem. To solve the non-convex quartic problem, a template matching sequence optimization (TMSO) algorithm is proposed. By introducing an auxiliary variable and problem transformation, the solution to the original problem can finally be obtained, involving two alternately iterative subproblems with closed-form solutions. Numerical experiments show that, compared with the reference algorithms, the proposed algorithm can not only obtain a transmit waveform with good Doppler tolerance, but also has a significant advantage in the execution efficiency.

articleTitle: Design Method of Dual Frequency Metasurface based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Multi frequency independent regulation is an important direction of metasurface multifunctional integration. However, the coupling between multiple frequency points is difficult to be completely eliminated. We introduce neural network into the design of dual frequency unit, which effectively reduces the coupling between dual frequencies and improves the performance of the unit.

articleTitle: Yagi Antenna Based on Dual-Element Folded Dipole
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel yagi antenna based on dual-element folded dipole is proposed. This antenna mainly consists of three leading patches, a dual-element folded dipole, a microstrip feedline and a metal reflector. The simulation results show that the bandwidth of the antenna is 1.05-2.45 GHz. In addition, the antenna has good directional radiation characteristics. In the 1.05-2.45 GHz band, the gain is approximately 10 dBi.

articleTitle: Research on Propagation Characteristics of 2.4 GHz Wireless Signals in a Steel Ship Cabin
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a ship model is established to study the propagation characteristics of 2.4 GHz wireless signal in the steel cabin. The transmission effect of the signal is simulated and the received power is calculated. In particular, the delay spread characteristics of signal transmission in the cabin are analyzed. Combined with the simulated results, we can analyze the propagation characteristics of 2.4 GHz wireless signal in the ship, and put forward suggestions on the deployment of wireless sensor network (WSN) nodes in the ship, so as to optimize the signal transmission efficiency in the ship.

articleTitle: Polyphase Orthogonal Waveform Design for MIMO Radar Based on Improved HHO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An improved discrete Harris Hawks Optimization based on genetic algorithm (GA-DisHHO) is proposed in this paper to enhance the correlation properties and reduce algorithm complexity in the design of orthogonal polyphase waveform for multiple input multiple output (MIMO) radar. Replacing Levi flight process with local cyclic variations, the crossover and mutation process of GA are utilized in GA-DisHHO to update individuals in order to achieve discrete optimization. Global searching and local searching are integrated in GA-DisHHO to improve the accuracy of solutions without any additional parameter setting. The simulation results showed the feasibility and effectiveness of GA-DisHHO algorithm.

articleTitle: State of Charge Estimation of Lithium-ion Battery based on Minimum Error Entropy Square Root Cubature Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To account for the impulsive non-Gaussian noises, a minimum error entropy square root cubature Kalman filter (MEE-SRCKF) is proposed to estimate the state of charge (SOC) of lithium-ion batteries. It adopts the robust minimum error entropy (MEE) criterion as the optimization criterion, instead of the MMSE or maximum correntropy criterion (MCC). And then the square root cubature Kalman filter (SRCKF) is used to deal with the nonlinearity. The performance of the proposed algorithm is validated by a pulsed discharge test and an urban dynamometer driving schedule (UDDS) test. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach has significantly improved the SOC estimation accuracy of the lithium-ion battery under non-Gaussian measurement noise compared with the SRCKF algorithm. In addition, given different initial SOC values, MEE-SRCKF algorithm also converges rapidly to its true value.

Author Keywords: minimum error entropy square root cubature Kalman filter

articleTitle: Design of a Single-Layer Wideband Filtering Slot Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a single-layer wideband filtering slot antenna without any extra filtering structures. The proposed antenna utilizes coplanar waveguide-fed (CPW) and mainly consists of a substrate, patch, irregular gap and unequal multistage branches, which can form a multimode slot resonator. From the simulated results, it is found that the −10 dB impedance bandwidth is from 2.09 to 3.09 GHz (38%) and the maximum gain is 4.7 dBi of the proposed slot antenna. Filtering characteristic can be observed from the gain response.
